/****************************************************************************
 * Name: social_alert_release_stale
 *
 * Description:
 *   Clear an alert that nothing has renewed, and say whether it did.
 *
 *   The other clear path lives inside social_emotion_step(), which only runs
 *   when a frame's emotion result arrives.  That makes it unreachable in the
 *   case that matters most: a user who has calmed down and looked away produces
 *   neither extreme results nor calm ones, only "no usable face", so the alert
 *   it raised had nothing left that could take it down.  See
 *   social_state_s::alert_extreme_ms for the measurement.
 *
 *   Called from the poll loop rather than from the result handler, so it runs
 *   on a timer the cloud cannot withhold.  Takes the lock itself because that
 *   loop releases it around each event.
 *
 * Returned Value:
 *   true when this call ended an alert, and the caller should post
 *   VS_APP_EVENT_SOCIAL_ALERT_CLEARED.
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: social_advice_sweep
 *
 * Description:
 *   Give up on advice the cloud is never going to send.
 *
 *   An extreme frame's entry is held so its msgEvent 1 result can be collected
 *   under the same msgId.  The interface defines no terminal state for a
 *   msgEvent 1 that will not be answered -- it goes to 11 and, if nothing
 *   comes, stays there -- so without a bound here such an entry is held for the
 *   rest of the session.  Enough of them and the table is full of permanent
 *   waiters, which is what forced the eviction that used to lose them.
 *
 *   Runs on the poll loop, taking the lock itself.
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

static void social_advice_sweep(void)
{
  uint64_t now = social_now_ms();
  uint8_t i = 0;

  pthread_mutex_lock(&g_social.lock);

  while (i < g_social.inflight_count)
    {
      struct social_inflight_s *entry = &g_social.inflight[i];

      if (social_inflight_waiting(entry) &&
          now - entry->image_at_ms >= CONFIG_VS_SOCIAL_ADVICE_TIMEOUT_MS)
        {
          char msg_id[VS_CLOUD_MSG_ID_MAX];

          snprintf(msg_id, sizeof(msg_id), "%s", entry->msg_id);
          social_inflight_remove(i);
          g_social.advice_expired++;

          pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_social.lock);
          printf("%s: no advice for msg %s within %d ms, giving up\n",
                 SOCIAL_TAG, msg_id, CONFIG_VS_SOCIAL_ADVICE_TIMEOUT_MS);
          pthread_mutex_lock(&g_social.lock);

          /* The removal shifted the tail down, so this index has to be looked
           * at again rather than advanced past.
           */

          continue;
        }

      i++;
    }

  pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_social.lock);
}

static bool social_alert_release_stale(void)
{
  uint64_t now = social_now_ms();
  bool cleared = false;

  pthread_mutex_lock(&g_social.lock);

  /* Both bounds have to pass, and they mean different things.  The cooldown is
   * the readability floor the alert is entitled to whatever happens next; the
   * hold is how long the absence of an extreme frame is allowed to be read as
   * "over" rather than as "between frames".
   */

  if (g_social.alert_active &&
      now - g_social.alert_since_ms >= CONFIG_VS_SOCIAL_ALERT_COOLDOWN_MS &&
      now - g_social.alert_extreme_ms >= CONFIG_VS_SOCIAL_ALERT_HOLD_MS)
    {
      g_social.alert_active = false;

      /* Bumped for the same reason the other two paths bump it: advice still in
       * flight for this alert would contradict a screen that has moved on.
       */

      g_social.alert_gen++;
      g_social.extreme_have = 0;
      g_social.extreme_head = 0;
      cleared = true;
    }

  pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_social.lock);

  if (cleared)
    {
      printf("%s: alert released, no extreme frame for %d ms\n", SOCIAL_TAG,
             CONFIG_VS_SOCIAL_ALERT_HOLD_MS);
    }

  return cleared;
}

 *   handle is still open, which is the only time these counters can be read.
 *
 *   Here because the chunk count alone cannot explain itself.  Measured
 *   2026-09-07 a 27.5 s session produced six 2-second chunks instead of the
 *   expected thirteen, with zero drops recorded on this module's own ring --
 *   so roughly half the conversation never reached it, and nothing in the log
 *   said where it went.  These four counters separate the candidates: dropped

 *   settled means the analog front end was still stabilising, clipped against

 *   count means the ADC itself under-delivered.
 *

/* The status panel's ordinary text colour, and what an emotion colour is
 * measured against.  Same value cloud_classify_emotion() gives a calm frame,
 * so a page reporting calm and a page reporting nothing look alike.
 */

#define VS_COLOR_NEUTRAL 0xe8eef2u

/* The emotion ring's colours when the cloud sent none.
 *
 * These have to be the same values cloud_classify_emotion() assigns, and for a
 * while they were not: blue got amber here and a real blue there, so the ring
 * changed colour depending on whether the reading came from the cloud or from
 * the local fallback while describing the same emotion.  Named rather than
 * spelled out at the point of use so the next divergence is at least visible.
 */

#define VS_COLOR_TENSE    0xe85d5du  /* red bucket:   生气, 反感 */
#define VS_COLOR_CONFUSED 0x5d8fe8u  /* blue bucket:  害怕, 伤心, 疑惑, 惊讶 */
#define VS_COLOR_HAPPY    0x48c78eu  /* green 愉悦 */

/* How long the cloud's advice for an extreme moment stays on screen.
 *
 * An advice is produced once per extreme run and arrives six to eighteen
 * seconds after the moment (AI-side log, 2026-09-08), so it is both scarce and
 * late -- the opposite of the emotion readings, which arrive every second or
 * two and are only worth the moment they describe.  It therefore gets its own
 * dwell rather than living and dying with the alert: it is replaced by the next
 * advice, and otherwise held for this long whatever the emotion does.
 *
 * Longer than VS_SOCIAL_ALERT_HOLD_MS on purpose.  The alert is a state and
 * ends when the state does; the advice is a sentence the user has to have time
 * to read, and an alert releasing under it is not a reason to take it away.
 */

#define VS_SOCIAL_ADVICE_PIN_MS 25000u

# autoflash — BK7258 免按 RST 自动烧录
`bk_loader` 只能靠拨 DTR/RTS 来复位板子，而这块板**没有自动复位电路**，所以原始流程需要人在 `Getting Bus...` 循环期间手按 RST。
`autoflash.sh` 用软件复位替代按键：在 `bk_loader` 握手循环期间，从另一个进程往同一个串口写 `reboot`，让还在运行的固件自己复位，正好撞上 bootrom 的监听窗口。
## 快速开始
```bash
sg dialout -c "./autoflash.sh -a"                 # 烧默认镜像，烧完自动挂串口
sg dialout -c "./autoflash.sh -b 1500000 -a"      # 高速烧录，40 秒而不是 4 分钟
sg dialout -c "./autoflash.sh -t"                 # 只测握手，不写 flash
```
需要 `sg dialout`（串口属 dialout 组）。
## 实现只有一份，在仓库根目录
`<repo>/autoflash.sh` 是唯一的实现。`.claude/skills/autoflash/autoflash.sh` 只是转发过去的壳子 —— 这里以前放着第二份实现，两份在时序处理上分叉到行为和日志格式都不一样，排查时先得发现"跑的不是这一份"，所以合并了。
不用改任何路径：脚本从自身位置往上走，找到含 `bk_loader` 的目录当作工作区根，再由它派生默认镜像 `bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/all-app.bin`。要覆盖就用环境变量：
```bash
VELA_ROOT=/your/workspace ./autoflash.sh -a       # 工作区根
BK_LOADER=/path/to/bk_loader ./autoflash.sh       # 直接指定烧录器
AUTOFLASH_RUNTIME_DIR=/tmp/flashlogs ./autoflash.sh   # 运行日志目录
```
日志实时打在当前 Shell，同时留档到 `<repo>/logs/runtime/autoflash-<时间戳>.log`。

input.title: 修复社交模式极端情绪建议链路
input.description: 已根据云端日志定位到 advice 丢失的真实原因（云端按 10s 窗口聚合判极端，且把 advice 挂在任意 msgId 上），完成 bug1/bug2/颜色逻辑修复、延长超时、advice 钉住显示与诊断日志，全量编译通过。

text:
改完了，全量编译通过。先说云端日志改变了什么结论。

## 云端日志推翻了我上一轮的推断

`social_assistant(2).log` 里两条证据决定了修复方向：

**云端的极端判定是窗口聚合，不是逐帧。** 8 次 `[extreme] 情感警告: 害怕` 全都发生在 `主要情感: 生气` 的窗口内；唯一一次 `[negative] 非极端` 是 害怕 单独出现时。也就是说一帧被识别为 害怕/中立/惊讶，仍然可能属于极端时刻。

**advice 挂在云端流水线当时手上的那个 msgId 上，与该帧本身的情绪无关。** 14:52:59 那条建议挂在 msgId=54 上，而 54 的图片 404 了三次、根本没分类成功。

端侧原来对这两点都做了相反的假设：非极端帧 `social_inflight_remove` 立即退休、图片失败帧也立即退休。于是绝大多数"advice 即将到达"的 msgId 恰好都被提前丢掉了，之后 advice 到达只能记进 `poll_unmatched`。这就是"几乎无法轮询到建议"的主因——不是云端慢。云端在争吵密集的会话里每 1~3 秒就推一条建议。

另外测到 advice 延迟 6.0 / 9.2 / 10.8 / 18.5 秒（四个会话，从首个极端帧算起），而 `ALERT_HOLD_MS` 是 12 秒，投递又硬要求 `alert_active` —— 所以侥幸没被丢掉的那些也被判为 discarded。

## 改了什么

**bug1（advice 丢失）** `social_inflight_s` 增加 `retire_at_ms`，任何结果到达都不再退休，而是进入 `VS_SOCIAL_ADVICE_GRACE_MS`（6 秒）宽限窗口；一旦确认极端或看到 msgEvent=1 开槽，就提升到完整的 `ADVICE_TIMEOUT_MS`。图片失败（status 30 + msgEvent 0）也走宽限，不再当成"不会有建议"。同批次内若 advice 排在退休之后被处理，`unmatched` 分支直接用事件自带的文本投递（advice 本来就不需要表项，表项只是记 generation 的地方）。淘汰顺序改为四级：已过期 → 仅宽限 → 无结果 → 真正等建议的。

**bug2（告警提前释放）** `social_alert_release_stale()` 恢复"有未决 advice 就不释放"，由每轮先跑的 sweep 兜底所以不会无界。advice 投递去掉了 `alert_active` 和 generation 两个前置条件——有文本就投递。

**建议钉住显示** 新增 `VS_APP_EVENT_SOCIAL_ADVICE` 事件和独立的 `runtime->advice_text`。原来 advice 和情绪文案共用 `alert_text`，所以下一个情绪结果（1~2 秒后）就把它冲掉了。现在只有下一条建议能覆盖它，情绪变化和告警清除都不会。

**颜色逻辑** 两处不一致：`VS_EMOTION_CONFUSED` 在 `cloud_classify_emotion` 里是蓝 `0x5d8fe8`、在 vs_app.c 回退里是琥珀 `0xe3ad4b`，同一个情绪来源不同就变色，已统一并命名为常量。状态栏"情绪升高"原来从 `VS_EMOTION_TENSE`（红桶）推断，而红桶含非极端的 反感、极端的 伤心 在蓝桶——两个方向都错。改成由事件新增的 `extreme` 标志驱动。

**超时** `ADVICE_TIMEOUT_MS` 30s → 60s，`INFLIGHT_MAX` 16 → 24（宽限窗口要占位），`VS_CLOUD_POLL_MAX_IDS` 16 → 24 并加了 `#error` 约束——表比一次 getResult 能问的 id 多，尾部就永远轮询不到。

**日志** 每条情绪结果打一行，含 `extreme_src` 标明是本地 emotionDetail 规则、同批次开槽还是更早开槽命中；开槽单独一行；unmatched 打出 msgEvent 和 status；超时区分"开过槽但云端没产出"和"从未开槽"。会话末尾新增两行汇总：`advice source`（grace/rescued/quiet）和 `holds`（grace_expired/never answered/release deferred）。下次跑完看 `advice source` 的 grace 数就知道这个修复救回了多少。

顺带修了一个协议解析盲区：服务端 status 21（图片判极端）若透传给 msgEvent=0，原来会被当成对端侧 21（advice attached），进 advice 分支后因 msgEvent 不匹配而什么都不做，情绪和极端标志一起丢。现在按 msgEvent 重映射为 EMOTION_DONE。

## 验证

编译环境缺 `ccache` 和 toolchain PATH，用了一个 shim 绕过。更重要的是 `.config` 里固化着旧值（`ADVICE_TIMEOUT_MS=30000`、`INFLIGHT_MAX=16`），Kconfig 改默认值不会生效——已删掉这两行跑 `olddefconfig` 重新取值，现在是 60000 / 24，`ADVICE_GRACE_MS=6000` 也进去了。

全量 ninja 通过。RAM 327192 B / 95.10%，基线（`logs/runtime/sdnand-speed-build.log`）是 326160 B / 94.80%，即 +1032 B，剩约 16 KB 余量。增大的 poll scratch（~18.5 KB）走 PSRAM 运行时分配，不占这个预算。唯一警告是既有的 nuttx `fs_fat32dirent.c` offset 警告。

没有上板验证。`advice source` 那行日志就是上板后判断修复是否生效的依据——grace 非零说明旧假设错在哪、错了多少。

# BK7258 OpenVela 项目技能规范

> 本文件是比赛仓内的项目级交付规范，路径以
> `/home/mi/vela_competition` 工作区根目录为基准；它在工作区根通用规则之上补充
> `external` 完整文件 overlay、构建与验收要求，以本副本为比赛仓内权威说明。

本文件是 AI 在本工作区进行 BK7258 OpenVela 移植开发时必须遵守的项目级操作规范。
它不复制各移植方案的具体设计，只固定稳定规则、当前状态、任务路由和验证门禁。
具体设计、寄存器表、协议结构和测试矩阵由比赛仓 `docs/plans/` 中的方案维护。

## 1. 证据与文档优先级

遇到文档与代码冲突时，按以下优先级判断，不得自行挑选更方便的结论：

```text
1. 当前源码和最终 .config
2. 生成的分区、布局、ELF、map、package manifest 和二进制哈希
3. 当前实板日志与测试记录
4. 比赛仓 docs/固件构建步骤.md
5. 最新的子系统移植方案
6. AP 总体移植方案
7. bk_avdk_smp / bk_idk / openvela / vendor_beken / 网页文档 / 官方 Markdown
8. 文档中的历史状态、建议代码和历史哈希
```

移植方案描述设计目标和某一时点的状态，不得覆盖当前源码、最终配置、生成文件或实板证据。

## 2. 工作区与仓库职责

```text
contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/autoflash.sh
    自动烧录脚本，当单片机连接到电脑，可使用脚本自动烧录固件验证。当cutecom占用串口，则kill cutecom
contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/
    BK7258 正式移植代码的唯一所有权目录，提交到 dev-ai-contest-2026 分支
contest/vendor/beken/
    构建入口符号链接，不是源码所有权目录，不要在此直接编辑
contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/docs/固件构建步骤.md
    已验证的 OpenVela AP + Armino CP 构建和打包流程
contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/README.md
    apps、nuttx、packages/ai_agent、bk_avdk_smp 四棵完整目标文件 overlay 的权威流程

## 3. 架构和资源所有权

### 3.1 固定架构结论

- BK7258 AP 是 Cortex-M33 / ARMv8-M Mainline / Thumb / hard-float，不是 Cortex-A / ARMv8-A。
- 不得引入 `arch/arm64`、GIC、AArch64、generic timer、MMU/页表、TF-A/BL31 或 `OUTPUT_ARCH(aarch64)`。
- BK7258 是三核 AMP：物理 CPU0 运行 Armino CP，CPU1 是 OpenVela AP primary，CPU2 是 AP secondary。
- AP 内部 SMP 时 CPU1/CPU2 运行同一个 `nuttx.bin`，映射为 NuttX 逻辑 CPU0/CPU1。
- 当前运行基线是 CPU1 单核，CPU2 SMP 尚未实现。

### 3.2 CPU0/CP 保留职责

CP 继续拥有并负责：

- bootloader、CP 固件和 FreeRTOS 运行环境
- 中央电源/时钟管理、硬件 WDT
- PSRAM PHY、电压、时钟、控制器和器件 ID 检测
- Flash 擦写编程
- Wi-Fi controller、RWNX/UMAC/LMAC/MAC/PHY/RF
- Bluetooth BTDM controller-only
- CP UART0 物理日志口

AP 不得重复执行与 CP 冲突的 PHY、时钟、电源或控制器初始化。

### 3.3 内存地址来源

Flash、SRAM、PSRAM 和保留区地址来自目标 `app_ab` 分区生成结果，不是 BK7258 芯片常量：

```text
AP Flash XIP:    0x02150000 (当前 app_ab 布局)
AP 私有 SRAM:    0x28010000..0x28064000 (336 KiB)
AP_SPINLOCK:     0x28000000..0x2800ffff
CP_RAM:          0x28064000..0x2809f6ff
PWR_MNG:         0x2809f700..0x2809f7ff
PSRAM 窗口:      0x60000000..0x60ffffff (当前 16 MiB 布局)
```

AP 不得清零 CP_RAM、PWR_MNG、SWAP，不得把 `AP_SPINLOCK` 放入 heap，不得覆盖 CP 的 128 KiB PSRAM heap。

### 3.4 AP 镜像注入

AP 镜像只能通过 `EXTERNAL_AP_BIN` 接口注入打包流程，不得手工覆盖 `package/tmp/app1.bin`。

### 3.5 AP 控制台

正式 AP 日志路径是 Mailbox UART -> CP UART0。物理 UART1 不是交付控制台，不接管 GPIO0/1。

### 3.6 安全状态

当前 Secure alias / CMSE 只表示按现有 AP 的 SPE 编译属性建立功能基线，不等于镜像已通过 secure boot。在安全启动、OTP/eFuse 和 CPU1 镜像认证闭环前，输出只能标注为开发构建。

## 代码改动

云端新规则让 `red` 和 extreme 变成等价（极端集合 = {生气, 反感, 伤心} = 整个 red 桶，伤心 从 blue 移到了 red）。所以主判据换成颜色：

```c
bool red = color != NULL && strcasecmp(color, "red") == 0;

*extreme = red ||
           (detail != NULL &&
            (strstr(detail, "生气") != NULL ||
             strstr(detail, "反感") != NULL ||

名称匹配没有删掉，保留作为第二条路径。理由是这两个轴只在云端主动对齐时才一致，而它们已经错开过一次（反感 曾是 red 但非极端，伤心 曾是极端但在 blue）。保留它还能覆盖"给了 detail 但颜色缺失/不在调色板内"的结果。

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: bk7258_report_cache
 *
 * Description:
 *   Reports whether this core implements instruction and data caches, and is
 *   left in at boot so the next person does not have to guess.
 *
 *   The AP executes in place from flash at 0x02150000.  NuttX did not enable
 *   the instruction cache until commit "perf(bk7258): enable the AP
 *   instruction cache", and every instruction fetch was a flash access: the
 *   expression renderer cost ~455ms per frame for work that takes 0.09ms on a
 *   host, a 51200-byte word-at-a-time copy ran at 0.8MB/s, and raising the
 *   core to 480MHz changed none of it because the core was never the limit.
 *   The same frame now costs 37ms.
 *
 *   Turning it on needed two independent fixes, and the first one alone looks
 *   like "the cache does nothing": CONFIG_ARMV8M_ICACHE depends on the hidden
 *   ARMV8M_HAVE_ICACHE, which this chip's Kconfig did not select, so asking
 *   for it in a defconfig was silently dropped; and selecting it only compiles
 *   up_enable_icache() in -- every other ARMv8-M chip in the tree calls that
 *   from its own start code, this one did not.  Both are fixed now (see the
 *   chip Kconfig and bk7258_start.c).
 *
 *   Only the I-Cache is on.  Instruction fetch is read-only and needs no
 *   maintenance against the camera, panel and mailbox DMA that shares AP RAM,
 *   which the MPU deliberately keeps non-cacheable.
 *
 *   CLIDR/CTR exist in ARMv8-M whether or not a cache is fitted (they read
 *   zero when it is not), so reading them is safe and settles the question:
 *   this part reports CLIDR=0x09200003, i.e. both caches are implemented.
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

static void bk7258_report_cache(void)
{
  uint32_t clidr = getreg32(0xe000ed78);   /* SCB->CLIDR */
  uint32_t ctr   = getreg32(0xe000ed7c);   /* SCB->CTR   */
  unsigned int l1 = clidr & 7;

  printf("cache: CLIDR=0x%08" PRIx32 " CTR=0x%08" PRIx32
         " L1=%s%s%s\n", clidr, ctr,
         (l1 & 1) != 0 ? "I" : "",
         (l1 & 2) != 0 ? "D" : "",
         l1 == 0 ? "none (uncached XIP from flash)" :
         (l1 == 3 ? " (separate I and D)" : ""));
}

void board_late_initialize(void)
{
  int ret = bk7258_bringup();

  bk7258_report_cache();

  if (ret < 0)
    {
      printf("board bring-up stopped, error=%d\n", ret);
      return;
    }

  printf("board bring-up initialization completed\n");

   * (BOARDIOC_FINALINIT) is never invoked in this minimal, apps-less NSH
   * configuration (no CONFIG_BOARDCTL_FINALINIT, no apps/nshlib start-up
   * script caller), so the test entry point is invoked here instead, from
   * the unconditionally-called CONFIG_BOARD_LATE_INITIALIZE hook.  See
   * docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-29-gc9d01-lcd-bringup.md Task 3 Step 3.
   */
#ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_GC9D01_FB

input.title: 定位并修复 bringup 失败（SRAM 堆耗尽）
input.description: bringup 失败不是构建问题：我把 inflight 表从 16 扩到 24 增加了 512B 静态 RAM，而启动堆是 .bss 之上的余量，仅 17KB，且 PSRAM 堆要靠 pwc 线程才能上线——kthread_create 因此失败。已把该表改为按会话从 PSRAM 分配，堆比原基线还多 1024B，固件已重新打包。

text:
是我的修改引起的，不是构建失败。新固件已重新打包好。

## 排查过程

先排除构建/烧录：烧录日志 `autoflash-20260908-195745` 显示 `file_crc: 0x6ede4e84`、`WriteFlash ->pass`、`{All Finished Successfully}`，且 19:54 和 19:57 两次烧录 CRC 相同。2000000 baud 没有问题，板上镜像是完好的。所以问题在镜像内容。

然后定位失败点。`bk7258_bringup()` 是线性的，日志里打出了 `mailbox UART0 link ready`（第 191 行）和 `IPC: HW_CTRL power-up acknowledged`，但没有下一条 `button GPIOs configured`。中间只有 `bk7258_pwc_start()`，而它内部除了一处之外每条失败路径都会打印：

```c
pid = kthread_create("pwc", 110, 2048, pwc_worker, NULL);
if (pid < 0)
  {
    return pid;          /* 唯一的静默返回 */
  }
```

从 heartbeat 到 abort 只隔了 14 ms，符合立即失败（不是 200 ms 信号量超时）。

## 根因

```
__heap_start = _ebss + 0x1000   ← 堆就是 .bss 之上的余量
__heap_end   = 0x28064000

HEAD    heap = 17384 B
我的     heap = 16872 B   (-512)
```

`up_allocate_heap()` 直接用 `__heap_start..__heap_end`，所以这个 app 每多一字节静态数据，启动堆就少一字节。

致命的是顺序：PSRAM 堆由 `bk7258_psram_initialize()` 里的 `kmm_addregion()` 加入，而那行在 `bk7258_pwc_start()` **末尾**（第 390 行）；把 PSRAM 弄上线的 `pwc` 线程本身在第 344 行创建。也就是说创建这个线程时，全系统只有那 17 KB SRAM 堆。前一个 kthread（heartbeat）刚好挤进去，`pwc` 的 2048 字节栈就挤不进了。

我把 `CONFIG_VS_SOCIAL_INFLIGHT_MAX` 从 16 提到 24，加上 `retire_at_ms`/`added_at_ms` 两个 uint64，`g_social` 从 2112 B 涨到 2968 B（+856），区段净增 512 B。一个社交功能的表把板子的启动搞挂了，而 bringup 根本不会碰这张表。

## 修复

把 inflight 表从 `.bss` 改成按会话从 PSRAM 分配 —— 它只在会话期间使用，而那时 PSRAM 早就在线了。做成指针而不是数组，`g_social.inflight[i]` 这 51 处索引写法一个字都不用改：

```c
struct social_inflight_s *inflight;
bool inflight_psram;
```

分配紧跟在 poll scratch 后面（同一个失败出口），释放紧跟在它后面，清零挪到分配处，`vs_social_start` 里改为把指针置 NULL。`social_inflight_add()` 加了一个 NULL 兜底——它跑在上传线程上，虽然当前顺序保证不会命中，但代价只是一次比较。

结果：

| | `g_social` | 启动堆 |
|---|---|---|
| HEAD（上次能启动） | 2112 B | 17384 B |
| 我的坏版本 | 2968 B | 16872 B |
| **现在** | **1240 B** | **18408 B** |

比原基线还多 1024 B 余量，功能一个也没砍（表还是 24 槽、宽限窗口还是 6 s）。

## 云端新规则的改动

`red` 现在与 extreme 等价，所以主判据换成颜色，名称匹配保留作第二路径：

```c
bool red = color != NULL && strcasecmp(color, "red") == 0;
*extreme = red || (detail != NULL &&
                   (strstr(detail, "生气") || strstr(detail, "反感") ||
                    strstr(detail, "伤心")));
```

`extreme_src` 现在打印 `red` / `detail` / `-`。出现 `detail` 就说明云端又把某个极端情绪移出了 red 桶。同步改了描述旧桶归属的注释（伤心 从 blue 移到 red，blue 只剩 害怕/疑惑/惊讶）。

## 新固件

```
all-app.bin  5709824 B  sha256 cab24af51623e33ac3c69e3225eeba2e2789636454a165b1b57ccf085e7cf2c5
app_ab_crc.rbl (OTA)
AP 三文件哈希一致: 5e4ef7e3ea4d18281d23403482f6628a6592bb68e4f4f20175426b1336bc789d, cmp = 0
RAM 325656 B / 94.65%   FLASH 1493312 B / 37.35%
```

烧录：`sg dialout -c "./autoflash.sh -b 2000000"`（2 Mbaud 这次证明可用，CRC 校验通过）。

## 一点建议

这块板的启动堆只有 17 KB，而且必须先从这 17 KB 里挤出一个内核线程才能把 2.9 MB 的 PSRAM 堆挂上来。任何人往 velasight 加静态数据都会重演这次故障，而症状是 `CPU1 boot timeout`，指向的地方跟原因八竿子打不着。两个可以考虑的结构性改法：给 `bk7258_pwc_start()` 里那个 `return pid` 补一行 printf（我没动 board 代码，因为你只让我改 app）；或者把 `pwc` 线程的栈来源改成静态数组，让它不依赖堆。
这个约束加入skills.md里。然后检查现在的社交极端情绪源码，各种情绪对应什么颜色？与云端的最新规定一样吗？

### 3.6 安全状态

当前 Secure alias / CMSE 只表示按现有 AP 的 SPE 编译属性建立功能基线，不等于镜像已通过 secure boot。在安全启动、OTP/eFuse 和 CPU1 镜像认证闭环前，输出只能标注为开发构建。

### 3.7 启动堆预算：应用静态数据直接吃掉它

AP 的内核堆就是 336 KiB SRAM 区段在 `.bss` 之上的余量，没有独立预留：

```text
up_allocate_heap() = __heap_start .. __heap_end
__heap_start = _ebss 之上 0x1000     (bk7258_allocateheap.c)
__heap_end   = 0x28064000
当前实测      = 18408 B
```

所以**任何 app 的静态数据（`.bss`/`.data`）都是从启动堆里直接扣的**，链接报告里的
`RAM %age Used` 就是这块预算的读数。

关键在顺序：2.9 MB 的 PSRAM 堆由 `bk7258_psram_initialize()` 的
`kmm_addregion()` 挂上，而那行在 `bk7258_pwc_start()` 末尾；把 PSRAM 弄上线的
`pwc` 内核线程本身在同一函数更早处用
`kthread_create("pwc", 110, 2048, ...)` 创建。也就是说 bring-up 期间**只有这十几 KB
SRAM 堆存在**，PSRAM 一个字节都用不上。

规则：

- 应用不得为只在运行期使用的数据声明大块静态数组。会话期数据按会话从 PSRAM
  分配（`social_alloc()` 之类 PSRAM-first 分配器），指针留在静态结构里。
- 改动任何 app 后都要看链接报告的 `RAM` 行，与改动前对比。增长必须有理由。
- 判断余量时不要看百分比，要算 `__heap_end - __heap_start`：

```bash
arm-none-eabi-nm cmake_out/bk7258-ap_ai_agent/nuttx | grep -E "__heap_start|__heap_end"
```

违反的症状与原因毫不相干，这是它值得单列一条的原因。实测 2026-09-08：
VelaSight 把一张会话期跟踪表从 16 项扩到 24 项，`.bss` 增加 512 B，启动堆从
17384 B 降到 16872 B，`kthread_create("pwc")` 随即失败。`bk7258_pwc_start()` 里
该调用的失败分支没有打印，于是 bring-up 只留下 `board bring-up stopped, error=-1`，
CP 侧报 `CPU1 boot timeout` / `OpenVela AP boot failed: -4102`。一个社交功能改坏了
板子的启动，而 bring-up 从不接触那张表。修复是把该表改为按会话从 PSRAM 分配。

input.description: 已把启动堆约束写入 SKILLS.md 3.7 与 §8 门禁；审计了情绪到颜色的全部映射点，端侧颜色完全跟随云端 emotionColor 字段，仅本地极端名单与 history 种子数据编码了情绪名，已修正种子里 伤心+blue 的过期配对并 bump 种子版本，固件已重打包。

text:
两件都做完了，固件已重新打包。

## SKILLS.md

新增 §3.7「启动堆预算：应用静态数据直接吃掉它」，放在架构与资源所有权一节，因为它是所有权约束而不是构建步骤。内容包括堆的来源（`__heap_start` 就在 `.bss` 之上）、PSRAM 堆要靠 `pwc` 线程才能挂上的先后顺序、三条规则（会话期数据走 PSRAM、改动后必须对比 `RAM` 行、算字节不看百分比）、以及这次的实测记录。

§8 静态验证清单加了一条：启动堆不得比上一个能启动的版本更小，并注明不能用百分比代替——0.15% 就够让 bring-up 失败。

## 情绪 → 颜色审计

结论：**端侧不自己决定颜色**。`cloud_classify_emotion()` 完全按云端下发的 `emotionColor` 字段分支，只有 green 桶内部用 `emotionDetail` 区分 愉悦/中立（因为一个颜色对应两个 UI 情绪）。所以颜色轴天然跟随云端，不存在过期风险。

当前映射：

| 云端 emotionColor | emotionDetail | UI 情绪 | RGB | 极端 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| red | 生气、反感、伤心 | `VS_EMOTION_TENSE` | `0xe85d5d` 红 | 是 |
| blue | 害怕、疑惑、惊讶 | `VS_EMOTION_CONFUSED` | `0x5d8fe8` 蓝 | 否 |
| green | 愉悦 | `VS_EMOTION_HAPPY` | `0x48c78e` 绿 | 否 |
| green | 中立（及其他 green） | `VS_EMOTION_CALM` | `0xe8eef2` 中性 | 否 |
| 缺失/未知 | — | `VS_EMOTION_NONE` | `0xe8eef2` 中性 | 仅按名单 |

`vs_app.c` 的回退调色板（云端没给 color 时按 emotion 取色）用的是同样三个常量 `VS_COLOR_TENSE/CONFUSED/HAPPY`，与上表一致。纪要百分比里 red+blue → tense、green愉悦 → happy、green中立 → calm，也一致。

`vs_voice.c` 也解析 `emotionColor`，但只是把字符串原样拼进文本行，没有映射，规则无关。

## 只有两处把情绪名写死

**极端判定名单** `vs_cloud.c:2458`：`生气 || 反感 || 伤心`，与云端最新规则一致。它是 `red` 的备用路径，两者当前完全重合。

**history 种子数据** —— 这里发现了不一致：`vs_history.c` 第 3 条演示记录把 `伤心` 配成 `"emotionColor":"blue"`（audioTimeline 和 emotionTimeline 各一处）。这是 伤心 还在 blue 桶时写的，新规则下这个组合已经不可能从云端出现。留着它会让同一个情绪在历史页显示成蓝色「疑惑」而在实时会话里显示成红色，等于用演示数据教了一个错的配对。

已改成 `red`，并把 `VS_HISTORY_SOCIAL_SEED_VERSION` 从 3 提到 4 —— 这个版本号存在卡上的 sidecar 里，落后就会在下次开机一次性重新播种，否则已经刷过机的板子上那条错记录不会被更新。

## 新固件

```
all-app.bin  sha256 6c6415cea1391c3597e01d711322aff0f311c39b4c44a5cb9d45a358e0938163
AP 三文件一致  fb62812a0299188d21789ae2e350305e877c5fd658f01b3727d65540479b0ead, cmp = 0
RAM 325656 B / 94.65%    FLASH 1493312 B / 37.35%
__heap_start = 0x2805f818  →  启动堆 18408 B（比上次能启动的版本多 1024 B）
```

`(0x28064000 - 0x2805f818) = 18408`，符合刚加进 SKILLS.md 的那条门禁。

cd /home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing && git commit -F - <<'MSG'
fix(velasight): collect the advice the cloud actually sends

The extreme-emotion path had never delivered an advice on hardware.  The
AI-side log of 2026-09-08 says why, and it is not latency: the device was
retiring the messages the advice was about to arrive under.

Two findings from that log.  The cloud applies its extreme rule to a
ten-second window rather than to a frame, so eight frames classified
害怕 were announced extreme because the window's aggregate was 生气 --
a frame this device reads as calm can belong to an extreme moment.  And
the advice is attached to whichever msgId the cloud's pipeline holds when
the text is ready, including one whose image never classified: at
14:52:59 an advice landed on msgId 54, whose image had 404ed three times.

So neither "this frame was calm" nor "this frame failed" means an advice
is not coming, and both used to retire the entry on the spot.  Every
answered message is now held for VS_SOCIAL_ADVICE_GRACE_MS on the chance
and promoted to the full timeout once there is a reason to expect one.
An advice that still arrives unmatched -- same batch, retired first -- is
delivered from the event, which carries its own text.

The alert release now waits for an outstanding advice, bounded by the
sweep that runs ahead of it, and delivery no longer requires a standing
alert: the advice is the only output an extreme moment produces and
showing it late beats withholding it.  It also gets its own event and its
own field, so the emotion readings that arrive every poll can no longer
overwrite it before it has been read.

The colour work is the cloud's current rule, where extreme is 生气, 反感
or 伤心 and all three are red.  Colour is the primary test and the three
names stay as a second path, since the two axes have come apart before;
extreme_src reports which fired.  The status line reads the verdict off
the event rather than off VS_EMOTION_TENSE, the UI fallback palette now
matches cloud_classify_emotion(), and the seed record that paired 伤心
with blue is corrected with a seed-version bump.

The in-flight table moves to PSRAM, and that is a boot fix rather than a
tidy-up.  Growing it from 16 to 24 entries added 512 bytes of .bss, and
the kernel heap is the tail of the RAM region -- 17384 bytes, and the only
heap that exists during bring-up, since kmm_addregion() for PSRAM runs at
the end of bk7258_pwc_start() while the thread that gets it there is
created earlier in the same function.  kthread_create("pwc") then failed,
bring-up returned -1 with no diagnostic, and CP reported CPU1 boot
timeout.  Allocated per session the table costs nothing at boot and the
heap ends up 18408 bytes, above where it started.  docs/SKILLS.md 3.7
records the constraint so the next static array does not rediscover it.
MSG

fix(velasight): centre the footer keys, and give the font its punctuation

Two unrelated things the right screen was getting wrong.

The first-row key hints were not symmetric about the panel centre.  When
the back key moved half a glyph inwards -- so that 按住结束, four
full-width glyphs in a 64 px box, started on the chord at x=16 rather
than 8 px past it -- the next key opposite it stayed where it was.  The
label creation site was updated to match and the per-frame setter was
not, so the row was drawn with the left box 32 px out from the centre and
the right one 40 px out.  The setter now agrees with the creation site at
x=80, mirroring 16..80 with 80..144.

That also fixes a clip the earlier change had missed rather than caused.
The comment claimed this slot never carries more than three glyphs, and
按住重置 on the hotspot page is four: the box ended at x=152 against a
chord of x=16..144 at y=128, so the last glyph was cut.  It now ends
exactly on the chord, the same clearance the left key gets from starting
on it.  The cost is that when both slots carry four glyphs -- only the
hotspot page -- their text meets at x=80 with no gap, and at 128 px of
chord for 128 px of text no arrangement both fits and separates them.

The font had no CJK punctuation at all.  Its lowest range above ASCII was
U+4E00, because the charset was built from GB2312 rows B0-D7, which hold
hanzi and nothing else, plus --range 0x20-0x7f.  So U+FF0C, U+3002,
U+3001, U+FF1A, U+FF1F and the quotation marks had no glyph and every one
of them rendered as a hollow box -- in the app's own strings, which use
ten such characters, and in all of the cloud's prose: the summaries, the
extreme-emotion advice and the transcript sentences are punctuated
Chinese.

The generator now takes GB2312 rows A1-A9 whole, which is what that
encoding defines as its symbol space, and additionally names the Unicode
punctuation blocks directly.  Both are needed: iconv lands on whichever
code point its table chose, so A1AA arrives as U+2015 rather than U+2014
and A1A4 does not produce U+00B7 at all, and the em dash and middle dot
were still missing after taking all nine rows.  795 glyphs and 19 KB of
flash, which the font shares with nothing; the boot heap is untouched at
18408 bytes.
MSG

text:
三件都做完了，两个提交，固件已重新打包。

## 提交

`02c8d64 fix(velasight): collect the advice the cloud actually sends` — 极端情绪链路（宽限窗口、告警释放等待、advice 钉住显示、red 判据、inflight 移到 PSRAM、SKILLS.md 3.7）。8 个文件。

`d2300c7 fix(velasight): centre the footer keys, and give the font its punctuation` — 下面两项。

## 页脚按键对称

原因不是布局设计，是两处代码不同步。`vs_display.c:220` 的创建点已经写了 NEXT 在 x=80（与 BACK 的 16 对称），但每帧调用的 `vs_panel_set_keys()` 里 NEXT 还留在 88 —— 当初 BACK 从 8 右移到 16 时只改了创建点。

```
改前: BACK 16..80 (中心 48, 距中心 32)   NEXT 88..152 (中心 120, 距中心 40)
改后: BACK 16..80 (中心 48, 距中心 32)   NEXT 80..144 (中心 112, 距中心 32)
```

顺带修掉一个不是这次引入、但一直没人发现的裁切：那条注释说右键"最多三个字"，可热点页的 `按住重置` 是四个字，64 px 正好填满盒子，右边缘落在 x=152。y=128 处的弦是 16..144，所以第四个字被切掉了。移到 80 之后右边缘正好压在弦上，和左键左边缘压在弦上是同一个余量。

代价：热点页同时有 `按住返回` 和 `按住重置` 两个四字标签时，文字在 x=80 处相接、没有间隙。该行弦宽 128 px，两个四字标签正好 128 px，这一行不存在既装得下又留间隙的排法。缺个间隙比缺半个笔画好。如果你想要间隙，唯一的办法是把这一行往上移（y 越小弦越宽），那要动 `VS_LOWER_TOP_Y`，会连带影响下面一行和分隔线，我没擅自动。

## 字库

查出来的原因比"符号不全"更彻底：**字库里根本没有任何中文标点**。cmap 里 ASCII 之上的最低范围是 `range_start = 19968`（U+4E00），也就是说 U+3000 段和 U+FF00 段一个字形都没有。

`generate_font.sh` 的字符集只有两部分：`--range 0x20-0x7f`（ASCII）和 GB2312 的 B0–D7 行。B0–D7 全是汉字，一个符号都没有。所以 `，。、：；？！“”…` 全部落空，显示成空心方框。你说的逗号只是最显眼的那个。

改法两条腿一起：

1. 字符集加上 GB2312 的 **A1–A9 行**（该编码定义的符号空间，682 个有效格），而不只是包含常用标点的 A1 和 A3 —— 这样以后云端吐出全角数字（A3）、圈号（A2）或制表符（A9）都不用再改一次。
2. 另外直接点名 Unicode 标点区块：`0xb7`、`0x2010-0x2027`、`0x3000-0x303f`、`0xff00-0xffef`。

第二条不是冗余。GB2312 是字节编码而正文是 UTF-8，iconv 落在它自己表里选的码位上：A1AA 出来是 U+2015 不是 U+2014，A1A4 根本出不来 U+00B7。所以取满九行之后，破折号 `—` 和间隔号 `·` 仍然缺。我在改之前跑了一遍验证才发现这点。

改完实测 43 个符号全部命中：

```
， 。 、 ： ； ？ ！ “ ” ‘ ’ （ ） 《 》 〈 〉 【 】 … — · ～ 　
％ ＆ ＃ ＠ ＋ ＝ ／ ｜ ① ② Ⅰ → ← ↑ ↓ ° ± × ÷      缺失: 无
```

新增 795 个字形，flash 从 37.35% 到 37.84%（+19 KB）。RAM 一个字节没变，字库是 `LV_ATTRIBUTE_LARGE_CONST` 在 flash 里，启动堆仍然是 18408 B。

## 1. ASR 连接是怎么建立的

端点常量在 `apps/packages/ai_agent/include/agent_config.h:375-380`：

```c
#define AGENT_DOUBAO_ASR_HOST    "openspeech.bytedance.com"
#define AGENT_DOUBAO_ASR_PORT    "443"
#define AGENT_DOUBAO_ASR_WS_PATH "/api/v2/asr"
#define AGENT_DOUBAO_ASR_CLUSTER "volcengine_streaming_common"
```

协议：**WebSocket over TLS（wss）**，火山 V2 二进制帧封在标准 WS 帧里，帧格式注释在 `volc_asr.c:17-34`。mbedtls 直连，TLS 1.2~1.3，ALPN `http/1.1`。

调用层次（三层，都很薄）：

| 层 | 文件:行 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `voice_asr_stream_open()` | `voice_asr.c:109-131` | 只是 `calloc` 一个 wrapper 转发给 volc |
| `volc_asr_stream_open()` | `volc_asr.c:1001-1043` | 真正的三步：TLS → WS upgrade → full_client_request |
| `asr_tls_connect()` | `volc_asr.c:116-214` | mbedtls 全套初始化 + connect + 握手 |
| `ws_upgrade()` | `volc_asr.c:287-357` | HTTP GET Upgrade，读 101 |
| `send_full_client_request()` | `volc_asr.c:531-601` | JSON 元数据帧 |

**鉴权：静态 appid + token，没有签名、没有临时凭据交换。** 两处都带：

- HTTP 头（`volc_asr.c:301`）：`"Authorization: Bearer;%s\r\n"` —— 注意是分号，不是空格，火山 V2 的写法。
- JSON body（`volc_asr.c:552-556`）：`app.appid` / `app.token` / `app.cluster`。

凭据每次打开都从 config store 重读（`volc_asr_init()`，`volc_asr.c:859-881`，键 `AGENT_CFG_KEY_VOLC_APPKEY` / `_VOLC_TOKEN` / `_VOLC_ASR_CLUSTER`）。这是设计意图：`vs_voice.c:52-57` 明确写了 volc_asr.c 故意不缓存内存态，所以 Web 保存凭据后下一次调用即生效。

安全性上有一处需要单独记一笔：`volc_asr.c:181` 是 `MBEDTLS_SSL_VERIFY_OPTIONAL`，**不校验服务端证书链**。这也解释了握手为什么只有几百毫秒——省掉了证书验证。

**没有任何额外 HTTP 预请求**：不换 token，不取临时 URL。

## 2. 2-3 秒延迟的构成

`volc_asr_stream_open()` 一次打开里，**每一项都是每次重做的，没有一次性摊销的部分**：

1. `mbedtls_ctr_drbg_seed()`（`volc_asr.c:127-133`）—— 每条连接新建 DRBG，走 `agent_secure_random()`。
2. **DNS**：`mbedtls_net_connect()`（`volc_asr.c:151`）内部 `getaddrinfo()`。工程里**没有 DNS 缓存**。
3. **TCP connect**：阻塞式，`mbedtls_net_set_block()` 在 connect 之后才设，`SO_RCVTIMEO` 30 s 也是之后才设（`volc_asr.c:159-167`）—— 所以 connect 本身没有独立超时，卡住就靠 TCP 栈默认值。
4. **TLS 握手**：`mbedtls_ssl_config_defaults` + `ssl_setup` + `mbedtls_ssl_handshake()` 忙等循环（`volc_asr.c:191-200`）。**全握手，无会话复用**：全仓库 `volc_asr.c` 里没有 `mbedtls_ssl_conf_session_cache()` 也没有 `mbedtls_ssl_set_session()`，config 是每条连接新建后立刻 free 的局部对象。
5. **WS upgrade**：1 个 RTT（发 GET，读到 `\r\n\r\n`，`volc_asr.c:307-350`）。
6. **首帧协议握手：只发不等**。`send_full_client_request()` 发完就返回，`volc_asr_stream_open()` 直接置 `ready=1`（`volc_asr.c:1039-1041`）——**不读服务端 ack**。所以这一步只花一次单向写的时间，不占 RTT。

已有的实测数字：

- `voice_channel.c:668-670`：`"TLS handshake (~300-800ms) completes before audio capture starts"`
- `voice_channel.c:635`：`"the entire ASR pre-connect (300-800ms)"`
- `voice_channel.c:395`：`"No pre-connected stream — open now (may lose first 300-800ms)"`

也就是说 **ASR 连接本身工程内实测是 300-800 ms，不是 2-3 s**。计时日志方面：批量路径 `volc_asr_recognize()` 有 `clock_gettime` 埋点（`volc_asr.c:891-892`、`963-985`，打印 `infer=%ldms e2e=%ldms`），但**流式路径 `volc_asr_stream_open()` 没有任何计时埋点**，只有两行 syslog 可以靠时间戳倒推：`"TLS connected to %s:%s"`（`volc_asr.c:211`）和 `"WebSocket upgrade OK"`（`volc_asr.c:355`）。

那 2-3 s 从哪来？看 worker 的实际顺序（`vs_voice.c:2658-2760`）：`malloc` 三个大 buffer → `vs_voice_conv_start()` → **（拍照路径）`vs_media_capture_jpeg()` 整张 JPEG 采集** → 才进 `vs_voice_record_and_recognize()`。而 `record_and_recognize` 里的顺序是（`vs_voice.c:1988-2010`）：**先 `voice_asr_stream_open()`，再 `vs_audio_capture_open()` + `vs_audio_capture_start()`**，两者都在 `VS_APP_EVENT_VOICE_LISTENING_READY` 之前。所以按键到"请说话"之间是 `摄像头(仅拍照路径) + ASR连接 + 麦克风打开` 三段串行，ASR 连接只是其中一段。摄像头那段有独立实测：sensor init 单独 1.4 s（`vs_app.c:3082-3088`）。

**建议先加埋点定位再动手**：只优化 ASR 连接，最好情况砍掉 300-800 ms，不会把 2-3 s 变成 0。

## 3. 连接生命周期

- **每次询问建新连接，而且是每一轮对话都新建一条**。`voice_asr_stream_open()` 在 `vs_voice_record_and_recognize()` 里（`vs_voice.c:1989`），而这个函数在多轮循环里被反复调用（`vs_voice.c:2745-2755`）。三轮对话 = 三次完整 DNS+TCP+TLS+WS。
- **明确不池化**。`volc_asr.c:88` 的注释就是 `/* TLS context for ASR connection (not pooled — single use) */`。
- 关闭点：`volc_asr_stream_finish()`（`volc_asr.c:1056-1112`，正常收尾）和 `volc_asr_stream_abort()`（`1114-1128`，取消/失败），都调 `asr_tls_free()`（`216-224`）做 `close_notify` + `net_free` + 释放 config/DRBG。
- **keepalive/ping**：只有被动响应。`recv_volc_response()` 收到 `WS_OPCODE_PING` 回 PONG（`volc_asr.c:655-672`），注释记录了这是实测踩出来的：`"Seen in practice once a session runs long enough (~8s) for the server to probe the connection"`。客户端**不主动发 ping**，**没有任何空闲超时逻辑**。
- **服务端空闲超时**：代码里没有直接记录，但有两个可用的硬数字 —— 上面的 PING ~8 s，以及 `start_silence_time = 3000`（`volc_asr.c:580`）。后者是真正的杀手：会话开始 3 s 内无语音 → 服务端返 1013 → `recv_volc_response` 映射为 `-ENODATA`（`volc_asr.c:78-86` 注释 + `838-841`）。`vad_silence_time = 800`（`volc_asr.c:581`）是尾静音。

2. `VS_PAGE_HISTORY` + `VS_KEY_CONFIRM`（`vs_app.c:2563-2635`）：读 history index → `vs_voice_ready()` 门禁（没好就显示"准备中"，`2580-2585`）→ `vs_begin_request()` → **先置 `voice_arming = true` + `page = VS_PAGE_VOICE_LISTENING` + `vs_render_now()`**（`2607-2611`，注释解释为什么要先画帧）→ `vs_voice_start()`。

## 5. 资源约束

**一条 ASR 连接的内存**：`asr_tls_ctx_t`（`volc_asr.c:89-95`）= `mbedtls_ssl_context` + `mbedtls_ssl_config` + `mbedtls_net_context` + `mbedtls_ctr_drbg_context`，内联在 `struct volc_asr_stream`（`volc_asr.c:996-999`）里，通过 `calloc` 从**默认 SRAM 堆**分配。真正的大头是 `mbedtls_ssl_setup()` 内部的 in/out buffer；我在 `board/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/configs/ai_agent/defconfig` 里**没有找到 `MBEDTLS_SSL_IN/OUT_CONTENT_LEN` 的覆盖**，所以按默认 16384 算是 2×~16.4 KiB —— 这一点我没有实测确认，建议直接量。

工程自己的口径可参考 `apps/packages/ai_agent/Kconfig:278-285`：`AI_AGENT_TLS_CONN_POOL_SIZE`，`"Each slot uses ~12KB BSS (TLS context + raw buffer)"`，range 1-4，default 2。

**帧缓冲**：接收每帧 `malloc(WS_BUF_SIZE=4096)`（`volc_asr.c:637`，`WS_BUF_SIZE` 定义在 `volc_asr.c:70`）；发送每帧 `malloc(8 + plen)`（`send_volc_frame`，`volc_asr.c:505`）+ 1 KiB 栈上 mask 缓冲（`ws_send_frame`，`volc_asr.c:405`）；录音循环栈上 3200 字节。`vs_voice.c:140-142` 记录了 4 KiB 的依据：一个火山结果装在一个 4 KiB WS 响应帧里。

**socket / TCP 上限**（defconfig）：`CONFIG_NET_TCP_PREALLOC_CONNS=12`（:223）、`CONFIG_NET_TCP_NWRBCHAINS=12`（:224）、`CONFIG_IOB_NBUFFERS=60` @ `CONFIG_IOB_BUFSIZE=1514`（:135-151，:150 附近还有关于 `tcp_get_recvwindow()` 与 IOB 关系的实测注释）。12 条 TCP 不是瓶颈，IOB 池才是共享稀缺资源。

**社交模式运行时已占用的**（`vs_cloud.c` 文件头注释 8-48 行是最好的一手材料）：

- 一条常驻 cleartext 连接，`g_cloud_keep_lock` 全序列化（`vs_cloud.c:374-405`，`cloud_keep_take()` 在 `1356`）
- TLS 路径委托给 `vela_tls.c`，即 pool 的 2 个 slot + 2×8 KiB **静态** raw buffer（`vela_tls.c:656-660`），而且 `vs_cloud.c:33-40` 明确警告："vela_tls.c reads every response through one of two static 8 KiB buffers taken under a mutex (s_tls_raw_buf), with a blocking wait on the first when both are busy... Worth knowing before concluding that concurrent uploads and polls are independent."
- 2 个上传 worker（`CONFIG_VS_SOCIAL_UPLOAD_WORKERS`，`vs_social.c:95-96`）+ 1.5 s 一次的 poll
- pool 满了会退化成 ephemeral context（`vela_tls.c:1017` `"Pool full — use a temporary ephemeral context"`），也就是**并发 TLS 上下文数量实际上没有硬上限**

**PSRAM vs SRAM**：`vs_cloud.c:27-31` 响应缓冲 PSRAM 优先、SRAM 兜底；但 `vs_cloud.c:42-48` 说明 cJSON 用全局 hooks 走普通 malloc → SRAM，且因为 hooks 是 process-global 且被 vs_history.c / vs_voice.c 共用，故意没改。mbedtls 也是 SRAM。**所以常驻一条预连接 = 常驻占 SRAM。**

不过好消息：**冲突面比想象的小**——预连接只在社交模式没运行时存在（见第 6 点），两者天然不同时。

**暂停也不算空闲**：`vs_social.h:96-103` —— pause 只停生产，poll 继续跑，摄像头不 STREAMOFF、麦克风不关（因为 resume 重新协商的时间"long enough to be visible"）。

UI 页面枚举在 `vs_types.h:140-173`。可以认为空闲的状态只有这几个：`VS_PAGE_HISTORY`、`VS_PAGE_HISTORY_BLANK`、`VS_PAGE_VOLUME`（这三个构成浏览环），加上 `VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_RESULT` 之后回落的浏览页。判据可以直接用 `vs_social_active() == false`（`vs_app.c:3064` 有现成调用）+ `page` 在浏览环内 + voice 不 busy。

**所以方案应该重新表述为**："设备停在浏览/历史页（社交未运行）时，提前建立 ASR 预连接"。

---

## 7. 现有的连接复用/预热机制

**最重要的发现：`voice_channel.c` 已经实现了完全一样的思路**，只是提前量很小（就提前到 spawn 录音线程之前）：

- `voice_channel_start()`（`voice_channel.c:665-681`）：`voice_asr_stream_open()` 存进 `s_voice.asr_stream`，注释写明动机 —— 不预开的话握手会在音频已经在流的时候跑，丢掉前 300-800 ms 语音。
- `recording_thread()`（`voice_channel.c:383-411`）：锁下取走 stream 并把 `s_voice.asr_stream` 置 NULL（所有权转移），拿不到就现场开 + 走 batch fallback。
- 失败清理（`voice_channel.c:693-700`）：capture open 失败时 `voice_asr_stream_abort(pre_stream)`。

这套所有权转移 + 失败回退的骨架**可以直接照搬**，但注意 velasight 是刻意不用 voice_channel.c 的：`vs_voice.c:25-35` 解释了原因（要绕开状态机、要可取消、要自己持有结果）。所以要在 `vs_voice.c` 里复刻，不是去调 voice_channel。

**其他机制**：

- `vela_tls.c` 的 keep-alive pool（`304-397`：`pool_acquire` / `pool_release` / `vela_tls_pool_cleanup`，复用逻辑在 `940-1053`，`969-970` 打印 `"Reusing pooled connection"`，`1009-1010` 处理 stale 重连）。**借不了**：它是 per-HTTP-request 的 acquire/release 语义，`in_use` 在一次请求内独占，无法承载一条长期 in_use 的 WebSocket；而且 `volc_asr.c` 根本不 include 它，自己有一套私有 TLS 客户端。
- **没有 TLS session ticket / session 复用**（这反而是比预连接更便宜、风险更低的替代方案：加一个 host 级的 `mbedtls_ssl_session` 缓存 + `mbedtls_ssl_set_session()`，只砍握手不砍 DNS/TCP，但没有 3 s 静音窗口的问题）。
- **没有 DNS 缓存**。
- `vs_cloud.c` 的 "pooled connection" 指的就是 `vela_tls.c` 那个池；"cleartext connection" 是它自己那条常驻明文 socket + `g_cloud_keep_lock` 全序列化（`374-405`、`1356-1400`、`1938-1945`），和 ASR 无关。

---

## 8. 风险点（按严重程度）

1. **`start_silence_time = 3000`（`volc_asr.c:580`）—— 致命**。预开的会话最多能空转 3 s。超了服务端返 1013，`recv_volc_response` 转成 `-ENODATA`（`volc_asr.c:78-86`、`838-841`），UI 显示"未听清"。要么把预连接窗口做成 <3 s 的滚动重开（那还不如就地开），要么调大这个值，要么灌静音帧维持（但会改变 VAD 看到的东西，且和 `vad_signal=1` 交互不明）。
2. **PING 无人应答（`volc_asr.c:655-672`）**。PONG 只在 `recv_volc_response()` 里发，而它只被 `finish()` 调用。空闲预连接没有读线程 → ~8 s 后服务端可能判定客户端已死。预连接必须配一个 reader/心跳线程，这又和"同步不可打断"的现有设计冲突。
3. **`recv_volc_response()` 里的 `static size_t confirmed_len`（`volc_asr.c:795` 附近）是函数级 static，跨 stream 共享**。同时存在两条 ASR 流会互相破坏 transcript 偏移。如果预连接策略会导致两条流短暂共存（旧的还没 abort、新的已开），这里会出错。
4. **凭据代际问题**。`volc_asr_init()` 每次打开都重读 config store（`volc_asr.c:859-881`），`vs_voice.c:52-57` 明确说这是为了让 Web 保存立刻生效。预连接把这个"无缓存"设计破坏掉了：预开的会话携带旧凭据。`vs_voice_start()` 里已有 `credentials_reload_pending` 的处理（`vs_voice.c:3039-3049`），预连接需要接进同一套失效逻辑。
5. **内存/并发 TLS**：没有直接记录"并发 TLS 导致 OOM"的注释，但有两条相关证据 —— `vs_cloud.c:33-40` 的 s_tls_raw_buf 争用警告，和 `vela_tls.c:1017` 的 pool 满退化 ephemeral（意味着并发 TLS 上下文无硬上限，靠堆兜着）。defconfig `:259` 还有一条堆损坏的历史记录（`"it corrupted unrelated heap state (observed as the AP-side IPC heartbeat...)"`）。
6. **`-ENOKEY` 语义**：`vs_voice_record_and_recognize()` 在 stream open 失败时返 `-ENOKEY`（`vs_voice.c:1991-1993`），UI 按"凭据缺失"报错。预连接路径必须保留这个映射，否则网络抖动会被报成凭据问题。
7. **顺带一提（安全，非性能）**：`volc_asr.c:181` 的 `MBEDTLS_SSL_VERIFY_OPTIONAL` 不校验证书链。长期持有一条不验证的连接，暴露面比短连接更大。

**综合建议**：给现有链路加计时埋点先确认 2-3 s 的实际归属（很可能大头在摄像头/麦克风，不在 ASR）；如果确实要削 ASR 那 300-800 ms，优先做 **TLS session 复用 + DNS 缓存**（无 3 s 窗口风险、无心跳线程、内存增量只是一个 session blob），而不是常驻预连接会话。

  1. apps/packages/ai_agent/src/voice/volc_asr.c — ASR 连接的全部实现：域名/端口/鉴权、asr_tls_connect/ws_upgrade/send_full_client_request 三步、"not pooled — single use" 声明、start_silence_time=3000 与 ~8s PING 两个决定预连接可行性的硬约束

## 先纠正两个前提

**一、不存在"社交模式空闲时"。** `询问` 只挂在 `VS_PAGE_HISTORY`（vs_app.c:1041），`拍照提问` 挂在 `VS_PAGE_HISTORY_BLANK`（:1048/:1057）。社交会话跑起来时页面是 `SOCIAL_RUNNING/ALERT/PAUSED`，CONFIRM 键的语义是暂停/继续。而且社交模式暂停也不是空闲——`vs_social.h` 明确写了 pause 只停生产，轮询继续、摄像头不 STREAMOFF、麦克风不关。

所以方案应该表述为「设备停在浏览页、社交未运行时预连接」。这其实是好消息：预连接和社交上传天然不同时，资源冲突面比想象的小。

**二、收益上限被高估了。** 工程内对 ASR 连接的唯一实测是 **300–800 ms**，出现在三处注释里（voice_channel.c:395、:635、:668-671）。所以预连接最多砍掉 300–800 ms，不是 2–3 s。

那 2–3 s 在哪？看 `vs_voice_record_and_recognize()` 的实际顺序（vs_voice.c:1989-2012）：

```
voice_asr_stream_open()      ← 300-800ms
vs_audio_capture_open()      ← 串行，独立成本
vs_audio_capture_start()
→ VS_APP_EVENT_VOICE_LISTENING_READY   ← UI 才切到"请说话"
```

拍照路径还要在这之前跑完一整张 JPEG 采集。而 **流式路径一个计时埋点都没有**——批量路径 `volc_asr_recognize()` 有 `infer=/e2e=`（volc_asr.c:899-989），产品走的流式路径没有。所以 2–3 s 的分段归属从代码无法证实。

## 常驻预连接的三个硬约束

**1. `start_silence_time = "3000"`（volc_asr.c:580）——致命。**

会话打开后 3 秒内没有语音，服务端以 1013 收尾（`ASR_RESP_CODE_NO_SPEECH`，:90），映射成 `-ENODATA`，UI 显示"未听清"。**预连接窗口上限是 3 秒**，不是分钟级。提前 3 秒以上建好等着用，等来的是一条已经自己结束的会话。

**2. PING 没人应答。** 服务端约 8 秒探活（:660 的注释是实测踩出来的），PONG 只在 `recv_volc_response()` 里回（:665），而这个函数只在 `finish()`(:1086) 和批量路径(:958) 里被调用。一条预开但没有 reader 的流不会回 PONG，8 秒后可能被服务端判死。

**3. `stream_open` 不读 ack。** 三步走完直接 `ready = 1`（:1039），不等服务端响应。所以"连接已建立"是乐观的——鉴权失败、配额超限要到第一次读才暴露。预连接会把这个错误从"按键后立刻报错"推迟到"用户已经说完话之后"。

## 次要风险

`recv_volc_response()` 里 `static size_t confirmed_len`（:822）是**函数级 static，跨 stream 共享**。两条流短暂共存（旧的还没 abort、新的已开）会互相破坏 transcript 偏移。

凭据是刻意不缓存的：`volc_asr_init()` 每次打开都重读 config store，vs_voice.c:52-57 说明这是为了让 Web 保存立即生效。预连接会持有旧凭据，得接进现有的 `credentials_reload_pending` 失效逻辑。

`MBEDTLS_SSL_VERIFY_OPTIONAL`（:191）不校验证书链。常驻一条不验证的 TLS 连接，暴露面比短连接大。

feat(velasight): time the ASR open path, which nothing measured

The wait between pressing 询问 and the device listening is reported as two
to three seconds, and the log could not say where any of it goes.

volc_asr's open path emitted two lines and they bracket only its cheap
half: "TLS connected" is printed at the end of asr_tls_connect() and
"WebSocket upgrade OK" at the end of ws_upgrade(), so the credential
read, the DRBG seed, the name resolution, the TCP connect and the whole
TLS handshake all happen before the first of them.  A board log of
2026-09-09 could therefore be read for 176 ms of upgrade and request work
and for nothing at all before it.

What that log did settle is that the microphone is not the cost.  Its
capture-level line reports the window measured from the listening event,
so the event can be placed at 48.819 against a session opened at 48.810 --
nine milliseconds.  Everything else is upstream, in the part with no
timestamps.

So volc_asr_stream_open() now reports every segment on one line: the
credential read, the DRBG seed, resolution and connect together, the
handshake, the upgrade and the first request.  Resolution and connect stay
one figure because mbedtls_net_connect() does both and does not say which
was which; separating them means resolving here and passing an address
literal on, a change to how the connection is made rather than to what is
recorded about it, and it is not worth making until this figure says the
pair is where the time is.  A tunnelled connect is labelled as such, since
it is not the same measurement as a direct one.  asr_tls_connect() takes
the breakdown as a nullable out-param, which is what the batch path passes:
it has its own infer/e2e marks.

vs_voice adds the other half, because the prefix ahead of the ASR call was
equally dark: worker spawn, three buffer allocations, vs_voice_conv_start()
and, on the photo path, a whole JPEG capture.  It reports the wait from
vs_voice_start() to the listening event alongside the ASR and microphone
shares of it, so the remainder is that prefix.  The request timestamp is
module state rather than a new field in the public request struct, and
busy already serialises it to one round.

Read together the two lines decide the pre-connect question posed against
this path.  A large handshake argues for caching the TLS session, which is
cheap and carries no protocol risk.  A large connect argues for caching the
resolved address and for splitting that figure next.  A small total argues
for leaving the connection alone, since a pre-opened session has to live
inside volc_asr.c's own start_silence_time of 3000 ms and answer the
server's ~8 s PING to stay usable.

volc_asr.c is a managed overlay file, so external/ carries the same bytes
and the packages_ai_agent digest is recomputed.  Verified by reproducing
the previous digest from the previous file before replacing it.

两个刻意的取舍：

走代理隧道时字段名会变成 `tunnel=`，因为隧道多一跳和一次请求，和直连不是同一个量，不该被当成同类比较。

埋点起作用了。这一轮的账是完整的，而且答案很明确。

## 你说的那个"可观延迟"，大部分已经被量到了

关键在于 `TLS connected` 是打在 `asr_tls_connect()` **最后**的。所以按下键到第一条日志出现的这段里，882 ms 是已经量到的 `dns+tcp(172) + handshake(710)`——它们全都发生在第一条日志**之前**。

反推时间轴对得上：

```
vs_voice_start()       25.184     (= 26.391 − 1.207)
stream_open 进入       25.192     (+8 ms 前缀)
TLS connected 打印     26.074     (+172 +710)   实际 26.075 ✓
```

真正没量到的只剩 `vs_voice_start()` **之前**那一小段，在 UI 线程上：输入任务派发 → 事件队列 → 主循环 → `vs_history_get_index()`（读 SD-NAND 上的 INDEX.JSN）→ **`vs_render_now()` 同步刷两块 QSPI 屏** → 才调 `vs_voice_start()`。参考之前 I-cache 那条记录里一帧约 37 ms，这段估计几十到两百毫秒，不是秒级。

所以从按键到"请说话"大约 1.25–1.4 s。之前那个 2–3 s 的估计偏高了。

## 时间花在哪

| 段 | 耗时 | 占比 |
|---|---|---|
| init（读凭据） | 0 ms | — |
| seed（DRBG） | 0 ms | — |
| dns+tcp | 172 ms | 14.7% |
| **handshake** | **710 ms** | **60.5%** |
| upgrade | 268 ms | 22.8% |
| request | 15 ms | 1.3% |

另外：`mic_open = 1 ms`，worker 前缀 `8 ms`，`voice_asr.c` 包装层 25 ms。**麦克风、内存分配、凭据读取全部不是问题**，这三个之前都是候选，现在都排除了。

**握手一段占了六成。** 而且它里面很可能大部分不是网络。用 `dns+tcp=172`（含 DNS + 1 个 TCP RTT）估 RTT 约 120–150 ms：

- 若协商到 TLS 1.2（2 RTT ≈ 300 ms）→ 约 **410 ms 是本地计算**
- 若协商到 TLS 1.3（1 RTT ≈ 150 ms）→ 约 **560 ms 是本地计算**

我确认了 defconfig 里**没有启用任何 `MBEDTLS_*_ALT` 硬件后端**，只有 `CONFIG_CRYPTO_MBEDTLS=y`。也就是说 ECDHE 的标量乘法、以及 `VERIFY_OPTIONAL` 下仍然会做的 ServerKeyExchange 签名验证，全是 Cortex-M33 上的纯软件实现。这和 410–560 ms 的量级是吻合的。

## 这直接决定了该做什么

**预连接是错的方向。** 它绕过的是整条 1173 ms，但代价是 `start_silence_time=3000` 的 3 秒窗口、一个心跳读线程、以及一条常驻的不校验证书的连接。而同样的收益有更便宜的拿法。

**该做 TLS session 复用。** 恢复握手（session ID / ticket）跳过密钥交换和签名验证——正好是那 410–560 ms 本地计算的全部，加上省掉一个 RTT。710 ms 有希望压到 150–200 ms，**整体 1173 → 约 600 ms**。而且没有 3 秒窗口问题、不需要心跳线程、内存增量只是一个 session blob。

这个工程里已经有先例，只是形式不同：`vela_tls.c` 有 keep-alive 连接池（:306 的注释就是"skip the TLS handshake"），HTTP 路径靠它避开握手，所以 FDS 上传和云端轮询才快。`volc_asr.c` 自带一套私有 TLS 客户端、不 include 它，也就完全没吃到这个好处。

顺带两个值得单独评估的：

`upgrade=268 ms` 比一个 RTT 明显偏大，差额是服务端处理 HTTP Upgrade 和鉴权的时间。这段端侧动不了。

**硬件加速的收益会远超本次话题。** 如果 BK7258 有 PKA/加解密引擎并接进 mbedtls 的 `_ALT` 钩子，受益的不只是 ASR——FDS 上传、LLM、TTS、云端轮询每一条 TLS 都会变快。这需要先查 vendor 树里有没有对应驱动，是一件独立的事。

## 下一步建议

要我做的话，顺序是：

1. 在 `asr_tls_connect()` 里加一行 `mbedtls_ssl_get_version()` 的日志。**一行，零风险**，但它决定上面 410 还是 560 的估计哪个对，也决定 session 复用能省几个 RTT。
2. 实现 session 复用（`mbedtls_ssl_session` 的 host 级缓存 + `mbedtls_ssl_set_session()`）。要注意火山服务端是否真的下发 ticket，不支持的话这个方案收益为零——所以第 1 步的日志最好一起把 `mbedtls_ssl_get_session()` 是否成功也打出来。
3. 如果还想再削，再给 UI 线程那段（history 读 + `vs_render_now`）加埋点。

要我继续做 1 和 2 吗？1 是纯日志，2 会动 `volc_asr.c` 的连接建立逻辑，属于公共仓文件，得走 overlay 同步那一套。

cd /home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing && git commit -F - <<'MSG'
feat(velasight): record what the ASR handshake negotiated

The first run with segment timing put 710 ms of a 1173 ms open inside the
TLS handshake, three fifths of it, and that number cannot be acted on as
it stands because it does not say what it is made of.

The rest of the line bounds it.  dns+tcp was 172 ms for a resolution plus
one round trip, so the link is somewhere near 150 ms; two round trips of
that do not reach 710, and this build compiles no MBEDTLS_*_ALT backend,
so the remainder is elliptic curve arithmetic and a signature check
running in software on a Cortex-M33.  Which of the two available fixes is
worth building depends on facts the log does not carry.

So a successful handshake now reports three of them.  The version, because
it decides how many round trips a full handshake spends and how many a
resumed one saves -- MBEDTLS_SSL_PROTO_TLS1_3 is absent from this build's
mbedtls config, so this is expected to read TLSv1.2 and the full handshake
to be two round trips, and the log is what confirms it rather than assumes
it.  The ciphersuite, because it names the key exchange and an ECDHE suite
is exactly the per-connection arithmetic a resumed session skips.  And
whether the server left a session worth resuming with, which is the one
fact that decides whether caching them is worth implementing:
MBEDTLS_SSL_SESSION_TICKETS is compiled in, so a refusal here is the
server's and not this client's.

The last is a probe: it copies the session and frees it immediately.
Nothing caches yet, and finding out whether a cache could work should not
require having built one first.  Only on the instrumented path, so the
batch path behaves exactly as before.

The other two figures from that run are also worth recording, because both
close off a candidate.  The microphone open was 1 ms and the worker prefix
-- spawn, three buffer allocations, conversation reset -- was 8 ms, so
neither is where the wait goes; 1198 of the 1207 ms before the device could
hear was the ASR open. What remains unmeasured is upstream of
vs_voice_start(), on the UI thread: the history index read and the
synchronous two-panel repaint that both run before it.

volc_asr.c is a managed overlay file, so external/ carries the same bytes
and the packages_ai_agent digest is recomputed.
MSG

日志加好，固件已重新打包并提交。

## 加了什么

握手成功后多打两行：

```
[volc_asr] TLS TLSv1.2 / TLS-ECDHE-RSA-WITH-AES-128-GCM-SHA256, resumable=yes
```

失败时补一行 `no reusable session: get_session -0xXXXX`。

三个字段各自回答一个问题：

- **version** — 决定全握手花几个 RTT、恢复握手能省几个。`MBEDTLS_SSL_PROTO_TLS1_3` 在这个 build 的 mbedtls 配置里**没有定义**（我查了两份 `mbedtls_config.h`），所以 `volc_asr.c:245` 的 `#if` 走 else 分支，max version 落在 TLS 1.2 → 全握手 2 个 RTT。日志是去**证实**这一点，不是替我假设。
- **ciphersuite** — 点出密钥交换方式。ECDHE 套件每条连接要付一次标量乘法，而这正是恢复握手完全跳过的部分。
- **resumable** — 服务端有没有给可复用的会话。`MBEDTLS_SSL_SESSION_TICKETS` 是**编进来的**，所以这里失败只能是服务端拒绝，不是客户端不支持。这一条直接决定 session 复用值不值得做。

第三项是探测式的：拷一份 session 立刻 free。现在还没有缓存，而"能不能缓存"的答案不该以"先建好缓存"为前提。只在带 `timing` 的流式路径上做，批量路径行为一字不变。

## 顺带确认的两个数

`MBEDTLS_SSL_IN_CONTENT_LEN` / `OUT_CONTENT_LEN` 都是 **16384**，所以一条 TLS 连接的收发缓冲是 2×16 KiB。这补上了上一轮我说"没实测确认"的那个数——常驻预连接会长期占 32 KiB，又多一个不选它的理由。

## 一个我自己踩的坑

我前面几次都是直接跑 `podman make` 打包，绕过了 `build_and_flash.sh`。结果 Armino 构建把 `projects/app_ab/cp/config/bk7258/config` 从最小种子展开成了完整生成配置，而恢复种子这件事是 `build_and_flash.sh` 做的（第 166-181 行）。所以这次 `prepare.sh check` 报了：

```
prepare.sh: error: bk_avdk_smp overlay mismatch: projects/app_ab/cp/config/bk7258/config
```

已按种子恢复，并改用 `./build_and_flash.sh` 重新打包。它自己打印了 `restored CP config seed: ...` 并重新跑了 overlay 校验通过。**后续打包我都走这个入口**，不再直接调 podman。

```

AP 三文件一致  17433843d7f6bdc2c251320e1e91bfb770d3f1475c0cadc1560b6969ddd1fb5f   cmp = 0
RAM 325656 B / 94.65%（未变）   启动堆 18408 B（未变）

提交 `8da2d10`。

## 烧录后要看的

```
[volc_asr] TLS <版本> / <套件>, resumable=<yes|no>
```

- `resumable=yes` → session 复用可行，直接做，预期把 handshake 从 710 ms 压到 150-200 ms，整体 1173 → 约 600 ms。
- `resumable=no` → 服务端不给票据，session 复用收益为零，得转向别的方向（缓存解析地址只能省那 172 ms 里的 DNS 部分；剩下就只有硬件加速或者预连接那套高代价方案）。

The jump to 791 ms in run 3 could indicate either a DNS cache miss or network contention—and looking at the log timestamps, there's audio playback happening and buffer pressure around that same time, which suggests the network might have been under stress.

The real issue is that I can't split this metric without changing how the connection is instrumented. Before I implement a DNS cache that might duplicate what NuttX already provides, I need to separate the DNS lookup time from the TCP connection time so I can actually see what's happening.

This split measurement will also reveal whether NuttX's existing DNS cache is even working, which means I might not need to add a second cache layer at all.

If DNS turns out to be the culprit, the fix could just be a config change to `CONFIG_NETDB_DNSCLIENT_ENTRIES` or investigating cache eviction — no new code required. input.oldStr:
* connect_ms covers resolution and the TCP round trip together, because
 * mbedtls_net_connect() does both and does not say where it spent the time.
 * Separating them means resolving here and passing the address on as a literal,
 * which changes how the connection is made rather than what is recorded about
 * it, and is not worth doing until this figure says the pair is the problem.
 */

struct asr_open_timing_s {
    uint32_t seed_ms;      /* mbedtls_ctr_drbg_seed, entropy included */
    uint32_t connect_ms;   /* name resolution and the TCP connect */
    uint32_t handshake_ms; /* config, setup and mbedtls_ssl_handshake */
    bool proxied;          /* went through a CONNECT tunnel instead */
};
input.newStr:
* Resolution and the connect are now separate figures, and the reason they had
 * to be is that together they were the largest and least stable term: three runs
 * on 2026-09-09 measured 172, 171 and 791 ms for the pair.  A fourfold spread
 * has two candidate explanations that call for opposite work -- a name lookup
 * that missed its cache, or a TCP connect that lost a SYN on a link whose IOB
 * pool was observed down to 55 of 60 in the same session -- and one figure
 * covering both cannot choose between them.
 *
 * The split is measurement only.  mbedtls_net_connect() is still handed the
 * hostname and still iterates every address it resolves, which is what makes a
 * v6-first answer on a v4-only link work; resolving here and passing a literal
 * on would have taken that away.  What this does instead is resolve once first
 * and time it, so that the resolution inside the connect is a cache hit and the
 * connect figure is the connect.
 *
 * That depends on NuttX caching answers, and it does: CONFIG_NETDB_DNSCLIENT is
 * enabled with eight entries and an hour of lifetime, and gethostentbyname_r()
 * consults that cache before it queries.  So the extra call costs a cache lookup
 * rather than a second query.  Were the cache ever turned off, dns_ms would stay
 * honest and tcp_ms would start including a query of its own.
 */

struct asr_open_timing_s {
    uint32_t seed_ms;      /* mbedtls_ctr_drbg_seed, entropy included */
    uint32_t dns_ms;       /* name resolution alone; 0 on the proxy path */
    uint32_t tcp_ms;       /* the connect alone, or the tunnel on the proxy path */
    uint32_t handshake_ms; /* config, setup and mbedtls_ssl_handshake */
    bool proxied;          /* went through a CONNECT tunnel instead */
    bool offered;          /* a cached TLS session was offered for resumption */
};

/* The one TLS session this client keeps, for resumption.
 *
 * Worth keeping because of what the first measurements said about the handshake:
 * 557 to 720 ms across three runs against a round trip near 150 ms, so most of
 * it is not the network.  This build compiles no MBEDTLS_*_ALT backend and the
 * server picked TLS-ECDHE-RSA-WITH-CHACHA20-POLY1305-SHA256, so every connection
 * was paying for a P-256 scalar multiplication and an RSA-2048 signature check
 * in software on a Cortex-M33.  A resumed handshake skips both and one round
 * trip with them.  The server offers the material to do it: the probe added with
 * the timing reported resumable=yes on every run.
 *
 * Credentials are deliberately not part of the key.  They travel inside the
 * tunnel -- the Authorization header on the upgrade and the appid/token in the
 * first request frame -- so a session says nothing about who is using it and a
 * credential change does not invalidate one.  This is the difference between
 * resuming a session and pre-opening a whole ASR stream: the second carries a
 * full_client_request built from credentials read at the time and would go stale
 * when they changed.
 *
 * One entry, because there is one endpoint.  Guarded because unlike the
 * credential statics beside it this outlives a call, and the cost of a mutex
 * held across two copies is not worth reasoning about the alternative.
 */

static pthread_mutex_t s_session_lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static mbedtls_ssl_session s_session;
static bool s_session_valid;

/* Forget the cached session.  Called when a handshake that offered it failed,
 * which is the only way this client learns that what it held was not usable.
 */

static void asr_session_drop(void)
{
    pthread_mutex_lock(&s_session_lock);
    if (s_session_valid) {
        mbedtls_ssl_session_free(&s_session);
        s_session_valid = false;
    }

    pthread_mutex_unlock(&s_session_lock);
}

     *
     * Measured 2026-09-09 the handshake was 710 ms of a 1173 ms open, three
     * fifths of it, against a dns+tcp of 172 ms that puts the round trip near
     * 150 ms.  Two round trips of that do not add up to 710, so the remainder is
     * local arithmetic -- and this build has no MBEDTLS_*_ALT backend, so the
     * curve and the signature check are software on a Cortex-M33.  These three
     * facts are what tell the difference between the two ways of shortening it.
     *
     *   version      decides how many round trips a full handshake costs and how
     *                many a resumed one saves.  TLS 1.3 is not compiled into
     *                this build, so this is expected to read TLSv1.2 and the
     *                full handshake to be two round trips.
     *   ciphersuite  names the key exchange, which is where the local time goes.
     *                An ECDHE suite pays a scalar multiplication per connection
     *                that a resumed session skips entirely.
     *   session      whether the server gave this client something to resume
     *                with.  MBEDTLS_SSL_SESSION_TICKETS is compiled in, so a
     *                failure here is the server declining rather than the client
     *                being unable, and it is the one thing that decides whether
     *                caching sessions is worth implementing at all.
     *
     * The probe copies the session and frees it immediately: nothing caches yet,
     * and finding out whether a cache could work should not depend on having
     * built one.  Only on the instrumented path, so the batch path keeps its
     * previous behaviour exactly.

        int saved;

- **放弃自建 DNS 缓存**（原计划任务已删除）。理由：NuttX 已有 `CONFIG_NETDB_DNSCLIENT=y` / `ENTRIES=8` / `LIFESEC=3600`，`gethostentbyname_r` 里 `lib_find_answer()` 在 `lib_dns_lookup()` 之前查缓存（`nuttx/libs/libc/netdb/lib_gethostentbynamer.c:768/778`）。再写一个是重复。若 DNS 真是瓶颈，正确修法是调 ENTRIES 或查驱逐（config 变更）。
- **dns/tcp 拆分用 `asr_warm_resolve()` 预解析计时，而不是把数字地址传给 `mbedtls_net_connect()`**。拒绝后者因为会丢掉 mbedtls 遍历所有解析地址的行为（v6-first 答案在 v4-only 链路上会失败）。预解析法零行为变更，第二次解析命中 NuttX DNS 缓存。
- **session 缓存不以凭据为 key、凭据变更不作废**。因为凭据在 TLS 隧道**内部**传输：`asr_tls_connect(ctx, host, port, timing)` 不收 token，凭据由握手后的 `ws_upgrade(..., s_token)`（`Authorization: Bearer;<token>`）和 `send_full_client_request(..., s_app_id, s_token, s_cluster)` 发出（volc_asr.c:1157/1166/1176）。我早期评估提的「凭据代际问题」只适用于预连接整个 ASR 会话。唯一作废时机：握手失败。
- **拒绝常驻预连接方案**。理由：`start_silence_time="3000"`（volc_asr.c:580）限制预开会话最多空转 3s；服务端约 8s 发 PING 而 PONG 只在 `recv_volc_response()` 里回、该函数只被 `finish()` 调用；且常驻占 2×16KiB（`CONFIG_MBEDTLS_SSL_IN/OUT_CONTENT_LEN=16384`）。

d4e6219
feat(velasight): time the handler that runs before the voice worker
The last unlit stretch of the wait before "请说话".  vs_voice.c measures
from vs_voice_start() and volc_asr.c breaks its own share down, so
everything after the key handler hands over was accounted for; the handler
itself was not, and it does two things that had never been timed -- a
history index read, and a synchronous flush of both panels.
Measured on the board it is 110 ms, and the split says which of the two it
is: index=0, render=109, start=1.  The index read is served from memory and
never touches SD-NAND, which was the candidate worth ruling out; the repaint
is the whole of it.  That is the price of painting an honest frame before
the worker starts, it is six percent of a 1801 ms wait, and it is not where
the problem is.
The photo path gets the same line without an index term, since it
references no record.  The capture it adds happens inside the worker and
already shows up as the gap between vs_voice's to_listen figure and its
asr plus mic figures.
Both lines print after the handover so they cannot delay the frame the user
is waiting on.  With these, the only part of the path still unmeasured is
the input task's queue latency, which is what is left over if the handler
and the worker figures do not add up to the observed gap.
---
afa1c9a
fix(velasight): label a social record from the code, not from the record
Shortening the title in the previous commit changed nothing on the board.
The title is written into the record at finalize, so the three records
already stored kept 面对面交流 -- five glyphs in a box that holds four --
and always would have, whatever the running firmware said.
The stored copy was never the right source for it.  This page shows only
VS_HISTORY_KIND_SOCIAL, every one of those carries the same string, and
grep finds current.title read in exactly one place: the title says which
kind of session it was, not which session.  It is a label for the kind.  So
vs_app.c now puts VS_HISTORY_SOCIAL_TITLE on the screen and never reads the
record's copy, which fixes the records already on a board along with the new
ones.  vs_social.c still writes the same constant, from the same header, so
a dump of the store keeps saying what each record is.
The date needed the opposite treatment: it really is per-record, so it
cannot come from a constant, and the previous commit's fix -- writing two
digits of year -- would have thrown the century away permanently to save
16 px on a 160 px screen.  The record keeps all four digits again and
vs_app.c trims them on the way to the label, so old records show the short
form too.  Anything that is not four digits and a dash passes through
untouched, which covers a blank date and leaves room for the format to move
again.
The precision in that snprintf is for the compiler, not for the output.
Reading current.date directly, gcc knew the source was one 40-byte field;
through a function returning a pointer into it, nothing says the string ends
before the struct does, so it widened the bound to date, title and summary
together and warned about truncating 209 bytes into 40 -- for a call that
cannot truncate.
Boot heap unchanged at 18408 B.  Warnings back to 24, none in velasight.

fix(velasight): set the timezone where the program actually starts, and fit
 the history page to its screen
The clock is right and the dates were still eight hours early, because the
timezone was set in main() and main() is not how this program starts.
bk7258_bringup.c declares velasight_autostart() weak and calls it once the
framebuffers are up; main() is reached only by typing "velasight ..." at

feat(velasight): record what the ASR handshake negotiated
The first run with segment timing put 710 ms of a 1173 ms open inside the
TLS handshake, three fifths of it, and that number cannot be acted on as
it stands because it does not say what it is made of.
The rest of the line bounds it.  dns+tcp was 172 ms for a resolution plus
one round trip, so the link is somewhere near 150 ms; two round trips of
that do not reach 710, and this build compiles no MBEDTLS_*_ALT backend,
so the remainder is elliptic curve arithmetic and a signature check
running in software on a Cortex-M33.  Which of the two available fixes is
worth building depends on facts the log does not carry.
So a successful handshake now reports three of them.  The version, because
it decides how many round trips a full handshake spends and how many a
resumed one saves -- MBEDTLS_SSL_PROTO_TLS1_3 is absent from this build's
mbedtls config, so this is expected to read TLSv1.2 and the full handshake
to be two round trips, and the log is what confirms it rather than assumes
it.  The ciphersuite, because it names the key exchange and an ECDHE suite
is exactly the per-connection arithmetic a resumed session skips.  And
whether the server left a session worth resuming with, which is the one
fact that decides whether caching them is worth implementing:
MBEDTLS_SSL_SESSION_TICKETS is compiled in, so a refusal here is the
server's and not this client's.
The last is a probe: it copies the session and frees it immediately.
Nothing caches yet, and finding out whether a cache could work should not
require having built one first.  Only on the instrumented path, so the
batch path behaves exactly as before.
The other two figures from that run are also worth recording, because both
close off a candidate.  The microphone open was 1 ms and the worker prefix
-- spawn, three buffer allocations, conversation reset -- was 8 ms, so
neither is where the wait goes; 1198 of the 1207 ms before the device could
hear was the ASR open. What remains unmeasured is upstream of
vs_voice_start(), on the UI thread: the history index read and the
synchronous two-panel repaint that both run before it.
volc_asr.c is a managed overlay file, so external/ carries the same bytes
and the packages_ai_agent digest is recomputed.

4c1c7be
feat(velasight): time the ASR open path, which nothing measured
The wait between pressing 询问 and the device listening is reported as two
to three seconds, and the log could not say where any of it goes.
volc_asr's open path emitted two lines and they bracket only its cheap
half: "TLS connected" is printed at the end of asr_tls_connect() and
"WebSocket upgrade OK" at the end of ws_upgrade(), so the credential
read, the DRBG seed, the name resolution, the TCP connect and the whole
TLS handshake all happen before the first of them.  A board log of
2026-09-09 could therefore be read for 176 ms of upgrade and request work
and for nothing at all before it.
What that log did settle is that the microphone is not the cost.  Its
capture-level line reports the window measured from the listening event,
so the event can be placed at 48.819 against a session opened at 48.810 --
nine milliseconds.  Everything else is upstream, in the part with no
timestamps.
So volc_asr_stream_open() now reports every segment on one line: the
credential read, the DRBG seed, resolution and connect together, the
handshake, the upgrade and the first request.  Resolution and connect stay
one figure because mbedtls_net_connect() does both and does not say which
was which; separating them means resolving here and passing an address
literal on, a change to how the connection is made rather than to what is
recorded about it, and it is not worth making until this figure says the
pair is where the time is.  A tunnelled connect is labelled as such, since
it is not the same measurement as a direct one.  asr_tls_connect() takes
the breakdown as a nullable out-param, which is what the batch path passes:
it has its own infer/e2e marks.
vs_voice adds the other half, because the prefix ahead of the ASR call was
equally dark: worker spawn, three buffer allocations, vs_voice_conv_start()
and, on the photo path, a whole JPEG capture.  It reports the wait from
vs_voice_start() to the listening event alongside the ASR and microphone
shares of it, so the remainder is that prefix.  The request timestamp is
module state rather than a new field in the public request struct, and
busy already serialises it to one round.
Read together the two lines decide the pre-connect question posed against
this path.  A large handshake argues for caching the TLS session, which is
cheap and carries no protocol risk.  A large connect argues for caching the
resolved address and for splitting that figure next.  A small total argues
for leaving the connection alone, since a pre-opened session has to live
inside volc_asr.c's own start_silence_time of 3000 ms and answer the
server's ~8 s PING to stay usable.
volc_asr.c is a managed overlay file, so external/ carries the same bytes
and the packages_ai_agent digest is recomputed.  Verified by reproducing
the previous digest from the previous file before replacing it.

input.text:
perf(asr): resume the TLS session, and separate resolution from the connect

Three runs of the segment timing put the handshake at 557, 710 and 720 ms of
opens costing 1173 to 1645 ms, against an upgrade -- one round trip -- of 266
to 315 ms.  Two round trips of that do not reach 557, so most of the handshake
is not the network, and the probe added with the timing said what the rest is:
TLSv1.2 with TLS-ECDHE-RSA-WITH-CHACHA20-POLY1305-SHA256, in a build that
compiles no MBEDTLS_*_ALT backend.  Every connection was paying for a P-256
scalar multiplication and an RSA-2048 signature check in software on a
Cortex-M33.  A resumed handshake skips both and a round trip with them, and the
same probe reported resumable=yes on every run, so the server was already
offering the material to do it and nothing was keeping it.

Now one session is kept and offered to the next handshake.  It is re-read on
every success rather than only the first, because a server may issue a fresh
ticket on a resumed handshake and the one just used may be single-use; saving
only once is what turns this into resuming exactly once on a device that stays
up for days.  It is dropped when a handshake fails, which is the only evidence
this client ever gets that what it held was not usable -- unconditionally,
because a full handshake failing has nothing to do with the cache, and dropping
a good entry costs one handshake while keeping a bad one costs every handshake
after it.  A server that declines the ticket does not fail; mbedtls carries on
with a full handshake, so there is no fallback path to write, only a figure that
comes back large.

Credentials are deliberately not part of the key.  They travel inside the
tunnel -- the Authorization header on the upgrade and the appid, token and
cluster in the first request frame -- so a session says nothing about who used
it and a credential change does not invalidate one.  That is the difference
between resuming a session and pre-opening a whole ASR stream, which was the
other candidate and is not built here: a pre-opened stream carries a
full_client_request assembled from credentials read at the time, has to live
inside this file's own start_silence_time of 3000 ms, and has to answer a PING
the server sends about every eight seconds with a PONG that is only written from
recv_volc_response(), which only finish() calls.  It would also hold two 16 KiB
mbedtls content buffers open while the device is idle.

The static is named s_tls_session rather than s_session because core/session_mgr.c
already has a file-static of the latter name for something else, and because
"session" in this file otherwise means the ASR session.  It is behind a mutex:
volc_asr_recognize() has no caller in the product and the voice worker is
serialised by g_voice.busy, so there is no contention today, but this is the one
piece of state here that outlives a call and a mutex held across two copies is
cheaper than the argument for leaving it out.

The other change is measurement.  dns+tcp was one figure and it measured 172,
171 and 791 ms -- a fourfold spread with two candidate causes that call for
opposite work.  Either a name lookup missed its cache, or a SYN was lost on a
link whose IOB pool was seen down to 55 of 60 in the same session.  One number
covering both cannot choose, so they are now two.

The split does not change how the connection is made.  mbedtls_net_connect() is
still handed the hostname and still walks every address the name answers with,
which is what makes a v6-first answer work on a v4-only link; resolving here and
passing a literal on would have taken that away for the sake of a figure.  What
happens instead is a getaddrinfo() ahead of it, timed, whose result is discarded
-- its purpose is to leave the answer in NuttX's DNS cache so that the lookup
inside the connect is a hit and the connect's figure is the connect.  That cache
is real: CONFIG_NETDB_DNSCLIENT is enabled with eight entries and an hour of
lifetime, and gethostentbyname_r() consults it before it queries.  Its failure
is not reported, because the connect will fail on its own with its own error
exactly as it did before, and a second opinion on that is not this function's to
give.  Were the cache ever disabled, dns would stay honest and tcp would start
carrying a query of its own.

Which also means a self-built DNS cache is off the table rather than pending.
The one that exists is consulted first; a second would be a duplicate.  If dns
comes back large twice in a row the answer is that eight entries are being
evicted by the other hosts this device talks to, and that is a config change.

The log now reads offered and held next to the negotiated version and suite, and
offered is what makes handshake_ms interpretable: offered=no with a large figure
is the first connection after boot and is meant to be slow, offered=yes with a
small one is a resumption, and offered=yes with a figure the size of a full
handshake is the server taking the ticket and declining to use it -- which looks
like nothing at all unless the two are read together.  On the proxy path dns is
zero and the tunnel keeps its own label, since a tunnel is a hop plus a request
and not a connect.

volc_asr.c is a managed overlay file, so external/ carries the same bytes and
the packages_ai_agent digest is recomputed.

Boot heap 18272 B, down 136 from 18408: the session struct, the mutex and the
flag.  No warnings from this file.  The three AP images -- nuttx.bin,
openvela-ap.bin and package/tmp/app1.bin -- are byte-identical at
abe3b178f252d1185a6adb10844b442c07b6616305d222edbdbc5543d0961bb4, and
all-app.bin is 5709824 B at
cab088a793db59a2b17fb0754b1f9fb35b3d78af98fc0a94d9ec5c343a96b490.

text:
做完了，提交是 `949f7ef`，改的是 `external/packages/ai_agent/src/voice/volc_asr.c` 加 `external/manifest.tsv` 两个文件，你原有的工作区没有别的改动被带进去。

改了两件事。TLS session 现在留一份、下次握手时提供出去，因为三轮实测的握手是 557/710/720ms 而一个往返只有 266~315ms，两个往返凑不出 557，剩下的是软件里跑的 P-256 和 RSA-2048 验签（这个 build 没编 `MBEDTLS_*_ALT`），而 probe 每轮都报 `resumable=yes` —— 服务端一直在给票据，只是没人收。每次握手成功都重存一遍，因为票据可能是一次性的，只存第一次等于只复用一次。凭据不参与缓存 key，它们在隧道里面传。

`dns+tcp` 拆成了两个数，因为它测出 172/171/791 这样四倍的摆动，而两种可能的原因要求完全相反的处理（名字查询没命中缓存，还是那条 IOB 池掉到 55/60 的链路丢了 SYN）。拆法是在 `mbedtls_net_connect()` 前面先 `getaddrinfo()` 计时、结果扔掉，让连接内部那次查询命中 NuttX 的 DNS 缓存。连接本身照旧拿 hostname，它遍历所有解析地址的行为一个字没动。

校验：`overlay verified (58 files, 1 auto_partitions newline-equivalent)`；`nuttx.bin` / `openvela-ap.bin` / `package/tmp/app1.bin` 三者 sha256 都是 `abe3b178f252d118...`，`cmp` 两次返回 0；`all-app.bin` 5709824 B，sha256 `cab088a793db59a2...`；启动堆 18272 B，比上一提交少 136（session 结构加锁加标志）。提交前顺手查过一个真实风险：TLS 1.2 恢复握手不重发证书，但 authmode 是 `VERIFY_OPTIONAL` 且整个 `voice/` 目录没人读 peer cert 或 verify result，所以没有回归。

烧录后看两行就够了：

`TLS ... offered=X held=Y` 里 `offered=yes` 且 `handshake=` 明显变小，就是复用生效了。`offered=yes` 但 handshake 还是五六百毫秒，是服务端收了票据却拒绝恢复，这种情况不看这两个字段是完全看不出来的。第一次连接必然是 `offered=no`，慢是应该的。

另外那 791ms 现在会分到 `dns=` 和 `tcp=` 里的某一侧。落在 dns 且连续两次都大，说明八条的 DNS 缓存被这台设备访问的其他主机挤掉了，那是改 config 的事；落在 tcp，就是链路或 IOB。

还有件你可能想知道的：四轮日志每次都以 `stream: aborted` 结束，走的是结束键那条 `vs_voice_end_conversation()` 路径而不是说完话的 `finish()`，所以 ASR 出文本 → LLM → TTS 这整条链到现在一次都没跑过。这次没动它。

有，而且这份日志把剩下的空间划得很清楚。先说复用的结果：`handshake` 从 618 掉到 132/137，省了约 480ms；那个 791ms 的悬案定案了，是 DNS 而不是 TCP。

| 轮次 | offered | dns | tcp | handshake | upgrade | request | 合计 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 冷启动 | no | **893** | 201 | 618 | 226 | 15 | 1969 |
| 2 | yes | 0 | 207 | 213 | 218 | 14 | 669 |
| 3 | yes | 0 | 114 | **132** | 217 | 14 | 493 |
| 4 | yes | 0 | 160 | 454 | 435 | 14 | 1079 |
| 5 | yes | 0 | 117 | 137 | 242 | 15 | 527 |

关键一点是：**复用已经榨干了**。恢复握手的 132ms 和 TCP 连接的 114ms 是同一个数，也就是一个往返，软件里的椭圆曲线和验签已经彻底不在账上了。稳态那 ~500ms 的构成是 tcp 一个往返 + TLS 一个往返 + upgrade 一个往返（其中约 105ms 是服务端处理 upgrade 的时间，115ms 的 RTT 撑不起 220ms）。所以再往下只能减往返，不能减计算。

第 4 轮是链路抽了一下，不是代码问题：handshake 和 upgrade 两个连续往返同时翻倍而 tcp 正常，且这一段日志里出现过 `network buffers low-water 56 of 60`。

按性价比排，还有这么几处：

**首次 DNS 那 893ms，值得先摘。** 它占冷启动 1969ms 的 45%，而且是一次真实往返不是重传（`RECV_TIMEOUT` 是 30s，893ms 够不上）。DNS 服务器是硬编码的 114.114.114.114，公网。做法是开机联网后或社交模式空闲时先解析一次 `openspeech.bytedance.com`，把答案放进 NuttX 那个缓存，零协议风险 —— 就是提前填一个已经存在的缓存。ASR 和 TTS 共用这个主机名，所以一次解析两条路都受益。缓存八条，这个产品实际解析的主机不多，但如果以后 `dns=` 又非零，就是被挤掉了。

**那 110ms 重绘可以和连接重叠。** `vs_app.c:2690` 现在是 `vs_render_now()` 花 110ms，然后 `vs_voice_start()` 花 1-2ms 起 worker。两者顺序换过来，worker 的 TCP 连接就和重绘并行，代价是用户看到那一帧晚 2ms。原来注释担心的"帧要诚实"说的是状态内容，而 `voice_arming` / `page` 两个状态在两者之前就已经写好了，换序不影响。顺带还能理顺 `-EBUSY` 那条路 —— 现在是先画监听帧再立刻重画浏览页。有个前提我没验证：显示写入会不会抢 worker 的 CPU，重绘期间 worker 主要在等网络，理论上重叠得很干净。

**TCP+TLS 预连接（停在 WS upgrade 之前），能到 ~240ms。** 我之前否掉的是预开整个 ASR 会话，理由是 `start_silence_time=3000`、8 秒的 WS PING、以及 `full_client_request` 会拿旧凭据。停在 upgrade 之前这三条一条都不成立：没有 ASR 会话就没有静音超时，没有 WebSocket 就没有 WS 层 PING，没有 full_client_request 就没有凭据过期。剩下的真实代价是两块 16KiB 的 mbedtls 缓冲空转（这个得先查它们从哪个堆来，启动堆只剩 18KB，PSRAM 堆 2.9MB 全空），以及服务端的 HTTP 空闲超时早晚会关掉它，需要检测加回退 —— 非阻塞 recv 看到 close_notify 是免费的，静默半关就得在写的时候吃一次重试。

**减往返的另外两条路我不建议先走。** TLS 1.3 的 early data 能省掉恢复握手那个往返，但这个 build 没编 TLS 1.3，开它要花 flash 还得服务端支持 early data；TCP Fast Open 要两端都支持。两者赌注都比预连接大，收益却不见得更多。

另外提醒一句，五轮全部以 `stream: aborted` 结束，仍然是结束键那条路。ASR 出文本 → LLM → TTS 整条链一次都没跑过，那一段目前没有任何数据。以整个对话的端到端延迟看，ASR 打开只是第一段，后面那几段可能比现在这 500ms 更值得量。

要动哪个？我倾向先做 DNS 预热加换序，两个加起来把冷启动从 2018ms 压到 ~1000ms、稳态从 650ms 压到 ~540ms，改动都小且可回退。预连接想做的话我先去查那两块缓冲的来源再给方案。

static uint32_t asr_now_ms(void)
{
    struct timespec ts;

    if (clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts) != 0) {

    }

    return (uint32_t)((uint64_t)ts.tv_sec * 1000u

/* Resolve host so that the connect after it does not have to.
 *
 * The result is thrown away on purpose.  This is not a lookup the connection
 * uses -- mbedtls_net_connect() does its own, and keeping that is what preserves
 * its walk over every address a name answers with.  This call exists to move the
 * cost of resolution out of the connect's figure and into one of its own, and it
 * is free to do so because the answer lands in NuttX's DNS cache where the
 * connect's lookup will find it.
 *
 * Failure is not reported.  If a name cannot be resolved here the connect will
 * fail on its own and say so, with its own error, exactly as it did before this
 * function existed; returning something would only invite a second opinion about
 * a decision that is not this function's to make.
 */

static void asr_warm_resolve(const char* host, const char* port)
{
    struct addrinfo hints;
    struct addrinfo* res = NULL;

    memset(&hints, 0, sizeof(hints));
    hints.ai_family = AF_UNSPEC;
    hints.ai_socktype = SOCK_STREAM;

    if (getaddrinfo(host, port, &hints, &res) == 0) {
        freeaddrinfo(res);
    }
}
